title: Immunoglobulin Use, Availability, and Administration Considerations in Measles Prevention
abstract: Abstract In 2026, the National Foundation for Infectious Diseases (NFID), with the Infectious Diseases Society of America (IDSA), convened a Measles Summit in response to the largest U.S. measles resurgence in over three decades, with more than 3,000 confirmed cases mostly among unvaccinated individuals. Many clinicians and public health professionals have limited firsthand measles experience, underscoring the need for clinical guidance. In this commentary, we examine immune globulin (IG) use for measles post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) amid fragile supply and logistical challenges. GamaSTAN®, the sole Food and Drug Administration (FDA)-licensed intramuscular IG product, faces episodic availability, non-returnable single-vial economics, and a 2013 recommendation to double the PEP dose, increasing per-patient demand. IVIG is increasingly employed when patients weigh 30 kg or more, beyond the weight at which an adequate dose of immune globulin can be given intramuscularly, or when IMIG supply is constrained, while concurrent lot withdrawals compromise institutional formularies. We review evidence-based patient selection for PEP, emphasizing that the Measles, Mumps, and Rubella (MMR) vaccine remains first-line within 72 hours of exposure, with IG reserved when vaccination is contraindicated or potentially ineffective. Immunosuppressive therapies vary widely in their effects on the safety and efficacy of live vaccines. We therefore argue against categorizing every biologic, immunomodulator, or steroid as an automatic MMR contraindication, which would overestimate IG-PEP demand and preclude MMR for eligible patients. We propose class-specific stratification and an electronic health record decision-support rule to better align IG demand with genuine need. Finally, we address declining potency standards for measles antibody, attributable to waning donor titers, and offer guidance on dosing, multi-site pediatric administration, and infusion logistics within the PEP window.

analysis.summary_en: This review addresses the use of immune globulin (IG) for measles post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) amid supply and logistical challenges. It highlights the resurgence of measles in the U.S. and the limitations of the FDA-licensed GamaSTAN® product, including its single-vial economics and the 2013 recommendation to double the PEP dose. The review emphasizes that the MMR vaccine remains the first-line intervention for measles PEP within 72 hours of exposure, with IG reserved for cases where vaccination is contraindicated or ineffective. It also discusses the variability of immunosuppressive therapies' effects on live vaccines and the declining potency of measles antibodies due to waning donor titers. The authors propose class-specific stratification and electronic health record decision-support rules to better align IG demand with actual need, while also addressing dosing and administration challenges within the PEP window.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述的重点是 麻疹病毒,特别审查了用于 麻疹 暴露后预防 (PEP) 的免疫球蛋白 (IG) 的使用、可用性和给药注意事项。核心问题是如何优化 IG 在 麻疹 预防中的使用,特别是在供应限制和后勤挑战的背景下。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该评论是评论,而不是系统评论或荟萃分析。它讨论了 麻疹 在美国重新流行的背景以及围绕 IG 供应的挑战,包括 FDA 许可的 GamaSTAN® 产品的单瓶经济性和 2013 年将 PEP 剂量加倍的建议。它还强调了由于 IMIG 的局限性,IVIG 在某些患者群体中的使用越来越多。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 审查得出的结论是,MMR 疫苗 仍然是暴露 72 小时内 麻疹 PEP 的一线干预措施,IG 保留用于 疫苗接种 禁忌或可能无效的情况。由于许多临床医生和公共卫生专业人员的第一手 麻疹 经验有限,它强调了临床指导的必要性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该评论指出,免疫抑制疗法对活体 疫苗 安全性和有效性的影响各不相同,并且反对将所有生物制剂、免疫调节剂或类固醇归类为自动 MMR 禁忌症。它还强调了由于供体滴度减弱而导致 麻疹 抗体效力下降,这可能会影响剂量和给药策略。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查建议对 IG 使用的患者进行特定类别的分层,并建议实施电子健康记录决策支持规则,以更好地将 IG 需求与真实需求结合起来。它还要求在 PEP 窗口内提供剂量、多站点儿科给药和输液物流方面的指导。

abstract_zh: 摘要 2026年,美国国家传染病基金会(NFID)与美国传染病学会(IDSA)召开了麻疹峰会,以应对美国三十多年来最大规模的麻疹疫情卷土重来,确诊病例超过3000例,其中大部分是未接种疫苗的个体。许多临床医生和公共卫生专业人员的第一手 麻疹 经验有限,这强调了临床指导的必要性。在这篇评论中,我们研究了在供应脆弱和后勤挑战的情况下免疫球蛋白 (IG) 在 麻疹 暴露后预防 (PEP) 中的使用。GamaSTAN® 是唯一获得美国食品和药物管理局 (FDA) 许可的肌内 IG 产品,面临着间歇性供应、不可回收的单瓶经济问题,以及 2013 年建议将 PEP 剂量加倍,从而增加了每位患者的需求。当患者体重超过 30 公斤或以上,超过可以肌内注射足够剂量的免疫球蛋白的体重时,或者当 IMIG 供应受到限制时,IVIG 的使用越来越多,同时批次撤回会损害机构处方。我们回顾了 PEP 的基于证据的患者选择,强调 麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹 (MMR) 疫苗 在暴露后 72 小时内仍然是一线药物,当 疫苗接种 有禁忌或可能无效时,保留 IG。免疫抑制疗法对活体 疫苗 安全性和有效性的影响差异很大。因此,我们反对将每种生物制剂、免疫调节剂或类固醇归类为自动 MMR 禁忌症,这会高估 IG-PEP 需求并排除符合条件的患者的 MMR。我们提出针对特定类别的分层和电子健康记录决策支持规则,以更好地将 IG 需求与真实需求保持一致。最后,我们解决了由于供体滴度下降而导致的 麻疹 抗体效力标准下降的问题,并提供了 PEP 窗口内的剂量、多部位儿科给药和输注物流方面的指导。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述的重点是 麻疹病毒,特别审查了用于 麻疹 暴露后预防 (PEP) 的免疫球蛋白 (IG) 的使用、可用性和给药注意事项。核心问题是如何优化 IG 在 麻疹 预防中的使用,特别是在供应限制和后勤挑战的背景下。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该评论是评论,而不是系统评论或荟萃分析。它讨论了 麻疹 在美国重新流行的背景以及围绕 IG 供应的挑战,包括 FDA 许可的 GamaSTAN® 产品的单瓶经济性和 2013 年将 PEP 剂量加倍的建议。它还强调了由于 IMIG 的局限性,IVIG 在某些患者群体中的使用越来越多。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 审查得出的结论是,MMR 疫苗 仍然是暴露 72 小时内 麻疹 PEP 的一线干预措施,IG 保留用于 疫苗接种 禁忌或可能无效的情况。由于许多临床医生和公共卫生专业人员的第一手 麻疹 经验有限,它强调了临床指导的必要性。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该评论指出,免疫抑制疗法对活体 疫苗 安全性和有效性的影响各不相同,并且反对将所有生物制剂、免疫调节剂或类固醇归类为自动 MMR 禁忌症。它还强调了由于供体滴度减弱而导致 麻疹 抗体效力下降,这可能会影响剂量和给药策略。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查建议对 IG 使用的患者进行特定类别的分层,并建议实施电子健康记录决策支持规则,以更好地将 IG 需求与真实需求结合起来。它还要求在 PEP 窗口内提供剂量、多站点儿科给药和输液物流方面的指导。

title: Efficient host transmission of measles virus: disentangling misconceptions from established findings
abstract: SUMMARY Measles virus (MeV) is considered the most contagious human virus. This review critically examines explanations for MeV’s extraordinary transmissibility. Although substantial progress has been made in understanding MeV infection, pathogenesis, and host spread, the fundamental question of why MeV is markedly more transmissible than other structurally similar respiratory viruses within the same taxonomic families remains unresolved. Many commonly cited explanations are either incorrect, oversimplified, or insufficiently supported by rigorous experimental evidence. Notably, there is a striking lack of studies that directly investigate the mechanisms governing MeV transmission. This knowledge gap persists in part because humans are the only natural reservoir for MeV, and thus the most relevant experimental models can be costly, technically challenging, and limited in ability. Moreover, studies addressing MeV environmental stability have relied largely on in vitro laboratory conditions that may have limited relevance to real-world transmission scenarios. While these studies have yielded useful observations, they often lack definitive mechanistic insight into efficient host-to-host spread. In this review, we discuss multiple strategies to investigate and define the efficient transmission of MeV, including (i) epidemiology, (ii) stability in controlled environments, (iii) infectious dose, (iv) incubation period, and (v) shedding from the respiratory epithelium. As will be discussed, quantitative, head-to-head comparisons of MeV transmission dynamics with those of other common respiratory viruses, such as influenza virus, rhinovirus, and respiratory syncytial virus, are notably absent. A clearer understanding of the mechanisms that govern efficient MeV transmission may inform strategies to reduce spread in educational, healthcare, and community settings.

title_zh: 麻疹病毒 的高效 宿主 传播:从既定结果中解开误解
source_body_en: SUMMARY Measles virus (MeV) is considered the most contagious human virus. This review critically examines explanations for MeV’s extraordinary transmissibility. Although substantial progress has been made in understanding MeV infection, pathogenesis, and host spread, the fundamental question of why MeV is markedly more transmissible than other structurally similar respiratory viruses within the same taxonomic families remains unresolved. Many commonly cited explanations are either incorrect, oversimplified, or insufficiently supported by rigorous experimental evidence. Notably, there is a striking lack of studies that directly investigate the mechanisms governing MeV transmission. This knowledge gap persists in part because humans are the only natural reservoir for MeV, and thus the most relevant experimental models can be costly, technically challenging, and limited in ability. Moreover, studies addressing MeV environmental stability have relied largely on in vitro laboratory conditions that may have limited relevance to real-world transmission scenarios. While these studies have yielded useful observations, they often lack definitive mechanistic insight into efficient host-to-host spread. In this review, we discuss multiple strategies to investigate and define the efficient transmission of MeV, including (i) epidemiology, (ii) stability in controlled environments, (iii) infectious dose, (iv) incubation period, and (v) shedding from the respiratory epithelium. As will be discussed, quantitative, head-to-head comparisons of MeV transmission dynamics with those of other common respiratory viruses, such as influenza virus, rhinovirus, and respiratory syncytial virus, are notably absent. A clearer understanding of the mechanisms that govern efficient MeV transmission may inform strategies to reduce spread in educational, healthcare, and community settings.

title: The 2026 measles resurgence in Bangladesh and its public health implications
abstract: Abstract Background Measles has resurged globally in the post-pandemic period as routine immunisation recovery remains below the two-dose threshold required to interrupt transmission. Bangladesh, previously nearing measles–rubella elimination, entered 2026 with widening coverage gaps, depleted vaccine stocks, and increasing numbers of missed children. We conducted a situation analysis to assess the scale, concentration, and programmatic implications of the outbreak. Methods We performed a rapid mixed-evidence review from 11–15 April 2026 using data from WHO, UNICEF, DGHS bulletins, PubMed/MEDLINE, ReliefWeb, SEARO updates, and Bangla-language media. Of 46 records screened, 19 were included. Analysis was based on aggregated, publicly available surveillance and programme data. Findings The DGHS measles press release dated 15 April 2026 reported cumulative totals since 15 March of 19,161 suspected cases, 2,973 confirmed cases, 166 suspected deaths, and 32 confirmed deaths; a WHO update dated 15 April reported 58 affected districts. The cumulative suspected-case burden was spatially concentrated: Dhaka and Rajshahi together accounted for 62.7% of suspected cases, and the division-level HHI was 0.255. Children under five comprised 81% of cases, including 34% infants under nine months. Vaccination status showed 72% zero-dose and 16% partially vaccinated cases. Valid MR1 coverage declined from 88.6% in 2019 to 86.1% in 2023, while valid MR2 coverage declined from 89.1% to 80.7%, indicating a widening immunity gap. Interpretation The resurgence reflects accumulated immunity gaps rather than vaccine failure, driven by subnational inequities and programme disruption. Urgent priorities include targeted vaccination campaigns, restoration of vitamin A supplementation, strengthening paediatric care capacity, and integrating real-time surveillance into outbreak response.

source_body_en: Abstract Background Measles has resurged globally in the post-pandemic period as routine immunisation recovery remains below the two-dose threshold required to interrupt transmission. Bangladesh, previously nearing measles–rubella elimination, entered 2026 with widening coverage gaps, depleted vaccine stocks, and increasing numbers of missed children. We conducted a situation analysis to assess the scale, concentration, and programmatic implications of the outbreak. Methods We performed a rapid mixed-evidence review from 11–15 April 2026 using data from WHO, UNICEF, DGHS bulletins, PubMed/MEDLINE, ReliefWeb, SEARO updates, and Bangla-language media. title: Factors associated with measles infection during the 2025–6 outbreak in Burao, Somaliland: a case-control study
abstract: Abstract Objectives Somaliland has recurrent measles transmission, but outbreak-specific evidence on modifiable child, household, and health-service factors is limited. We examined factors associated with measles case status during the 2025–6 Burao outbreak. Methods We conducted a community-based unmatched case-control study among children aged <15 years from 14 June to 8 July 2026. Cases were enrolled consecutively and controls sampled systematically from households using a random start and every fourth household. Cluster-robust logistic regression estimated adjusted ORs (aORs), with indeterminate responses modeled separately. Results Among 804 children (290 cases, 514 controls), case status was associated with non-vaccination (aOR 2.12, 95% CI 1.02–4.42), close contact (3.00, 1.72–5.25), reported health-facility attendance (2.79, 1.91–4.06), vaccine unavailability (2.62, 1.17–5.85), and trucked/vendor water (2.98, 2.03–4.36). Prior malnutrition, large-gathering attendance, household vaccination-refusal history, and poor ventilation were also associated. Health-facility attendance referred to the 21 days before rash onset/reference date, but exact visit dates were not collected. Conclusion Measles case status was associated with immunity gaps, contact, household conditions, and service-related factors. Response priorities include reliable vaccine availability, catch-up vaccination, and contact-based action. The health-facility attendance association is temporally ambiguous and does not establish healthcare-associated transmission.

analysis.summary_en: This case-control study investigated factors associated with measles infection during the 2025–6 outbreak in Burao, Somaliland. The research aimed to address the lack of outbreak-specific evidence on modifiable factors influencing measles transmission. Among 804 children, non-vaccination, close contact, health-facility attendance, vaccine unavailability, and use of trucked/vendor water were significantly associated with measles case status. The authors interpreted these findings as highlighting immunity gaps, contact patterns, household conditions, and service-related factors contributing to the outbreak. elements_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to identify factors associated with measles infection during the 2025–6 outbreak in Burao, Somaliland, as outbreak-specific evidence on modifiable child, household, and health-service factors is limited.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: A community-based unmatched case-control study was conducted among children aged <15 years from 14 June to 8 July 2026, with 290 cases and 514 controls enrolled.
elements_en.methods: Cases were enrolled consecutively, and controls were sampled systematically from households using a random start and every fourth household. Cluster-robust logistic regression estimated adjusted ORs (aORs), with indeterminate responses modeled separately.
elements_en.main_results: Among 804 children, case status was associated with non-vaccination (aOR 2.12, 95% CI 1.02–4.42), close contact (3.00, 1.72–5.25), reported health-facility attendance (2.79, 1.91–4.06), vaccine unavailability (2.62, 1.17–5.85), and trucked/vendor water (2.98, 2.03–4.36).
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as indicating that measles case status was associated with immunity gaps, contact, household conditions, and service-related factors, highlighting new insights into outbreak dynamics.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform targeted interventions such as improving vaccine availability, promoting catch-up vaccination, and implementing contact-based prevention strategies.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study has limitations due to the temporally ambiguous health-facility attendance association, which does not establish healthcare-associated transmission, and the use of a case-control design that may introduce bias.

title_zh: 索马里兰布劳 2025-6 麻疹 期间与 麻疹 感染相关的因素:病例对照研究
source_body_en: Abstract Objectives Somaliland has recurrent measles transmission, but outbreak-specific evidence on modifiable child, household, and health-service factors is limited. We examined factors associated with measles case status during the 2025–6 Burao outbreak. Methods We conducted a community-based unmatched case-control study among children aged <15 years from 14 June to 8 July 2026. Cases were enrolled consecutively and controls sampled systematically from households using a random start and every fourth household. Cluster-robust logistic regression estimated adjusted ORs (aORs), with indeterminate responses modeled separately. Results Among 804 children (290 cases, 514 controls), case status was associated with non-vaccination (aOR 2.12, 95% CI 1.02–4.42), close contact (3.00, 1.72–5.25), reported health-facility attendance (2.79, 1.91–4.06), vaccine unavailability (2.62, 1.17–5.85), and trucked/vendor water (2.98, 2.03–4.36). Prior malnutrition, large-gathering attendance, household vaccination-refusal history, and poor ventilation were also associated. Health-facility attendance referred to the 21 days before rash onset/reference date, but exact visit dates were not collected. Conclusion Measles case status was associated with immunity gaps, contact, household conditions, and service-related factors. Response priorities include reliable vaccine availability, catch-up vaccination, and contact-based action. The health-facility attendance association is temporally ambiguous and does not establish healthcare-associated transmission.

title: Population-level measles RT–PCR cycle threshold values and their relationships with disease severity, transmission, and incidence metrics: a time series analysis of the 2025–2026 outbreak in Mexico
abstract: Objectives To determine whether the weekly median real-time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT–PCR) quantification cycle (Cq) value of notified measles cases precedes the incidence, transmission, and severity metrics of an outbreak. We focused particularly on the effective reproduction number ( R t ). We also assessed whether any association persisted after adjustment for a linear time trend, specimen composition, and the outcome's own past. Methods We conducted a retrospective secondary analysis of 10,910 Cq determinations and 11,735 confirmed cases recorded in a single Mexican national case-level surveillance extract for Chihuahua and Jalisco. Twelve reported weekly metrics of incidence, transmission, and severity were examined by cross-correlation, four nested lagged regression models (M1–M4), formal Toda–Yamamoto Granger tests, and a secondary calibrated-lag autoregressive model. Moving-block bootstrap intervals were the primary method for regression inference. Autocorrelation-robust and classical methods were used in sensitivity analyses. Individual Cq determinations were analyzed separately against collection timing, severity, and vaccination history. Results Selected-lag associations were negative across all reported metric families, at leads of 1–9 weeks. The strongest negative correlation between Cq and DGE-derived R t occurred at +8 weeks in the second Chihuahua wave ( r = −0.745). In Jalisco, it occurred at +7 weeks ( r = −0.464). Only Jalisco supported the fully adjusted model 4 (M4). There, bootstrap intervals excluded zero for both the laboratory-positive-case and final surveillance-confirmed-case R t estimates but not for the two severity proportions. Excluding up to four endpoint weeks preserved the direction of both R t estimates. At the individual level, Cq increased with zero, one, and two documented vaccine doses (0.761 cycles per dose, 95% CI 0.589 to 0.932) and was 1.02 cycles lower in hospitalized cases. Conclusions Aggregate Cq showed the most consistent retrospective leading association with R t . The retrospective associations occurred at data-calibrated lags of 7–8 weeks during the second Chihuahua wave and in Jalisco. Conversely, leak-free forecasting supported incremental gain in one analytic unit at a median 2-week horizon. The operational predictive horizon of aggregate Cq therefore remains unvalidated. If prospectively validated, weekly aggregate Cq could complement conventional measles surveillance using laboratory information that is already routinely collected.

title_zh: 人群水平 麻疹 RT-PCR 循环阈值及其与疾病严重程度、传播 和 发病率 指标的关系:墨西哥 2025-2026 年 暴发 的时间序列分析
source_body_en: Objectives To determine whether the weekly median real-time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT–PCR) quantification cycle (Cq) value of notified measles cases precedes the incidence, transmission, and severity metrics of an outbreak. We focused particularly on the effective reproduction number ( R t ). We also assessed whether any association persisted after adjustment for a linear time trend, specimen composition, and the outcome's own past. Methods We conducted a retrospective secondary analysis of 10,910 Cq determinations and 11,735 confirmed cases recorded in a single Mexican national case-level surveillance extract for Chihuahua and Jalisco. Twelve reported weekly metrics of incidence, transmission, and severity were examined by cross-correlation, four nested lagged regression models (M1–M4), formal Toda–Yamamoto Granger tests, and a secondary calibrated-lag autoregressive model. Moving-block bootstrap intervals were the primary method for regression inference. Autocorrelation-robust and classical methods were used in sensitivity analyses. Individual Cq determinations were analyzed separately against collection timing, severity, and vaccination history. Results Selected-lag associations were negative across all reported metric families, at leads of 1–9 weeks. The strongest negative correlation between Cq and DGE-derived R t occurred at +8 weeks in the second Chihuahua wave ( r = −0.745). In Jalisco, it occurred at +7 weeks ( r = −0.464). Only Jalisco supported the fully adjusted model 4 (M4). There, bootstrap intervals excluded zero for both the laboratory-positive-case and final surveillance-confirmed-case R t estimates but not for the two severity proportions. Excluding up to four endpoint weeks preserved the direction of both R t estimates. At the individual level, Cq increased with zero, one, and two documented vaccine doses (0.761 cycles per dose, 95% CI 0.589 to 0.932) and was 1.02 cycles lower in hospitalized cases. Conclusions Aggregate Cq showed the most consistent retrospective leading association with R t . The retrospective associations occurred at data-calibrated lags of 7–8 weeks during the second Chihuahua wave and in Jalisco. Conversely, leak-free forecasting supported incremental gain in one analytic unit at a median 2-week horizon. The operational predictive horizon of aggregate Cq therefore remains unvalidated. If prospectively validated, weekly aggregate Cq could complement conventional measles surveillance using laboratory information that is already routinely collected.
abstract_zh: 目的 确定通知的麻疹病例的每周中位数实时逆转录聚合酶链反应(RT–PCR)定量循环(Cq)值是否在发病率、传播和严重程度指标之前发生。我们特别关注有效繁殖数(Rt)。我们还评估了在调整线性时间趋势、样本组成和结果自身历史后,任何关联是否仍然存在。方法 我们对墨西哥一个国家层面的监测数据集进行了回顾性二次分析,该数据集记录了奇瓦瓦州和哈利斯科州的10,910个Cq测定值和11,735个确诊病例。通过交叉相关分析、四个嵌套滞后回归模型(M1–M4)、正式的Toda–Yamamoto格兰杰检验以及一个二次校准滞后自回归模型,分析了十二周报告的发病率、传播和严重程度指标。移动块自举区间是回归推断的主要方法。在敏感性分析中使用了自相关稳健和经典方法。对个体Cq测定值分别与采集时间、严重程度和疫苗接种历史进行分析。结果 所选滞后关联在所有报告的指标家族中均为负值,滞后时间为1至9周。在奇瓦瓦州第二波中,Cq与DGE衍生的Rt之间的最强负相关出现在+8周(r = −0.745)。在哈利斯科州,出现在+7周(r = −0.464)。只有哈利斯科州支持完全调整的模型4(M4)。在那里,自举区间排除了零,对于实验室阳性病例和最终监测确认病例的Rt估计值,但未排除两个严重程度比例。排除最多四个终点周仍保留了两个Rt估计值的方向。在个体层面,Cq随着零、一、两剂记录的疫苗剂量而增加(每剂0.761个循环,95% CI 0.589至0.932),并且住院病例的Cq值比非住院病例低1.02个循环。结论 整体Cq在回顾性分析中与Rt表现出最一致的领先关联。回顾性关联发生在奇瓦瓦州第二波和哈利斯科州的数据校准滞后7–8周。相反,无泄漏的预测支持在一个分析单位中,中位数2周的预测范围内有逐步增加。因此,整体Cq的操作性预测范围尚未验证。如果前瞻性验证成功,每周整体Cq可能可以补充传统的麻疹监测,利用已经常规收集的实验室信息。

title: Oncolytic measles virus reprograms the tumor microenvironment in a vascularized mesothelioma-on-chip model
abstract: Abstract Background Pleural mesothelioma (PM) is a rare and aggressive cancer primarily caused by asbestos exposure. Although dual immune checkpoint inhibition (anti-PD-1/anti-CTLA-4) is now approved as first-line therapy, clinical benefit is limited to a small subset of patients, necessitating the need for alternative strategies. Oncolytic viruses represent a promising therapeutic approach as they selectively infect and lyse tumor cells and display immunogenic properties. In PM, we showed that the oncolytic activity of measles virus (MV) is primarily dependent on alterations in the type I interferon (IFN-I) pathway. However, to date no in vitro models have yet been developed to mimic a sophisticated tumor microenvironment (TME), and accurately evaluate MV efficacy in PM. Methods We designed a humanized 3D “vascularized mesothelioma-on-chip” (VMOC) model using microfluidic chips that mimic a TME. VMOC are generated using primary endothelial cells, lung fibroblasts and patient-derived PM cells. We characterized the functionality of our model by confocal imaging, perfusion assay and single-cell RNA sequencing. The impact of MV on the VMOC was assessed by bulk transcriptomics, multiplex ELISA and deconvolution strategies, and compared to clinical data in patients with PM. Results We first proved VMOC functionality with an appropriate endothelial barrier integrity, perfusability, and vascular responsiveness to external stimuli. We demonstrated significant heterogeneity in the VMOC, with the presence of different mesenchymal, cancer and endothelial subpopulations. Interestingly, the addition of PM cells to the VMOC reduced both the IFN-I pathway in cells from the TME, and the abundance of a novel endothelial cell subset characterized by an IFN-I signaling signature. Following MV administration via the endothelial network, we detected PM cell infection and death, as well as strong activation of the IFN-I pathway with the production of multiple inflammatory mediators. Interestingly, the proteomic and transcriptomic inflammatory response induced by MV in VMOCs was similar to that induced in PM patients treated with an oncolytic virus. Conclusions The VMOC model we developed enables in vitro investigation of MV infection and TME reprogramming, paving the way for a deeper understanding of the TME role in OV responses and the development of novel strategies to improve clinical efficacy.

source_records.abstract: Abstract Background Pleural mesothelioma (PM) is a rare and aggressive cancer primarily caused by asbestos exposure. Although dual immune checkpoint inhibition (anti-PD-1/anti-CTLA-4) is now approved as first-line therapy, clinical benefit is limited to a small subset of patients, necessitating the need for alternative strategies. Oncolytic viruses represent a promising therapeutic approach as they selectively infect and lyse tumor cells and display immunogenic properties. In PM, we showed that the oncolytic activity of measles virus (MV) is primarily dependent on alterations in the type I interferon (IFN-I) pathway. However, to date no in vitro models have yet been developed to mimic a sophisticated tumor microenvironment (TME), and accurately evaluate MV efficacy in PM. Methods We designed a humanized 3D “vascularized mesothelioma-on-chip” (VMOC) model using microfluidic chips that mimic a TME. VMOC are generated using primary endothelial cells, lung fibroblasts and patient-derived PM cells. We characterized the functionality of our model by confocal imaging, perfusion assay and single-cell RNA sequencing. The impact of MV on the VMOC was assessed by bulk transcriptomics, multiplex ELISA and deconvolution strategies, and compared to clinical data in patients with PM. Results We first proved VMOC functionality with an appropriate endothelial barrier integrity, perfusability, and vascular responsiveness to external stimuli. We demonstrated significant heterogeneity in the VMOC, with the presence of different mesenchymal, cancer and endothelial subpopulations. Interestingly, the addition of PM cells to the VMOC reduced both the IFN-I pathway in cells from the TME, and the abundance of a novel endothelial cell subset characterized by an IFN-I signaling signature. Following MV administration via the endothelial network, we detected PM cell infection and death, as well as strong activation of the IFN-I pathway with the production of multiple inflammatory mediators. Interestingly, the proteomic and transcriptomic inflammatory response induced by MV in VMOCs was similar to that induced in PM patients treated with an oncolytic virus. Conclusions The VMOC model we developed enables in vitro investigation of MV infection and TME reprogramming, paving the way for a deeper understanding of the TME role in OV responses and the development of novel strategies to improve clinical efficacy.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the potential of oncolytic measles virus (MV) in treating pleural mesothelioma (PM), a rare and aggressive cancer linked to asbestos exposure. The researchers developed a humanized 3D "vascularized mesothelioma-on-chip" (VMOC) model to mimic the tumor microenvironment (TME) and evaluate MV's efficacy. They demonstrated that MV's oncolytic activity is influenced by changes in the type I interferon (IFN-I) pathway. The VMOC model showed appropriate endothelial barrier integrity, perfusability, and vascular responsiveness, and revealed significant heterogeneity in the TME. The addition of PM cells to the VMOC reduced IFN-I pathway activity and altered the endothelial cell composition. MV administration led to PM cell infection and death, along with strong IFN-I pathway activation and production of inflammatory mediators. The proteomic and transcriptomic inflammatory response induced by MV in VMOCs mirrored that seen in PM patients treated with an oncolytic virus. The study highlights the potential of the VMOC model for investigating MV's effects on the TME and developing new therapeutic strategies. The findings are based on in vitro experiments and comparisons with clinical data, but the study does not report limitations or evidence strength.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 胸膜间皮瘤 (PM) 是一种罕见的侵袭性癌症,主要由石棉暴露引起。尽管双重免疫检查点抑制(抗 PD-1/抗 CTLA-4)现已被批准作为一线治疗,但临床获益仅限于一小部分患者,因此需要替代策略。溶瘤病毒代表了一种有前途的治疗方法,因为它们选择性地感染和裂解肿瘤细胞并表现出免疫原性。在 PM 中,我们发现 麻疹病毒 (MV) 的溶瘤活性主要依赖于 I 型干扰素 (IFN-I) 途径的改变。然而,迄今为止,尚未开发出体外模型来模拟复杂的肿瘤微环境 (TME),并准确评估 MV 对 PM 的疗效。方法我们使用模仿 TME 的微流控芯片设计了人性化 3D“芯片上血管化间皮瘤”(VMOC) 模型。VMOC 使用原代内皮细胞、肺成纤维细胞和患者来源的 PM 细胞产生。我们通过共聚焦成像、灌注测定和单细胞 RNA 测序来表征我们模型的功能。通过批量转录组学、多重 ELISA 和反卷积策略评估 MV 对 VMOC 的影响,并与 PM 患者的临床数据进行比较。结果我们首先证明了 VMOC 具有适当的内皮屏障完整性、可灌注性和血管对外部刺激的反应性的功能。我们证明了 VMOC 存在显着的异质性,存在不同的间充质、癌症和内皮亚群。有趣的是,将PM细胞添加到VMOC中既减少了来自TME的细胞中的IFN-I途径,也减少了以IFN-I信号传导特征为特征的新型内皮细胞亚群的丰度。通过内皮网络给予 MV 后,我们检测到 PM 细胞感染和死亡,以及 IFN-I 途径的强烈激活和多种炎症介质的产生。有趣的是,MV 在 VMOC 中诱导的蛋白质组和转录组炎症反应与用溶瘤病毒治疗的 PM 患者诱导的相似。结论 我们开发的 VMOC 模型能够对 MV 感染和 TME 重编程进行体外研究,为更深入地了解 TME 在 OV 反应中的作用以及开发提高临床疗效的新策略铺平道路。

title: Measles ( rubeola) virus qualitative real-time reverse transcription–polymerase chain reaction assay: development and clinical validation on an automated workflow
abstract: Abstract Introduction Detection of Measles virus (MeV) RNA is an important method for confirming infection. This study described the clinical validation of a qualitative real-time reverse transcriptase–polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) assay for MeV detection. Methods A real-time RT-PCR assay was developed and validated using primers and probes previously reported in the literature. The assay was evaluated using reference materials, cultured virus, and previously tested clinical throat swab samples. An automated workflow was established for RNA extraction, RT-PCR amplification, and result reporting using robotic platforms and a real-time PCR instrument. The assay targets the measles nucleoprotein (N) and hemagglutinin (H) genes, with human RNase P gene used as an internal control. Results The MeV RT-PCR assay has a limit of detection of 500 genome copies per milliliter. The assay was tested against 85 different samples: 50 positive clinical samples and reference materials and 35 negative clinical samples or reference materials. All expected results were correctly identified, giving 100% sensitivity (50/50) and specificity (35/35). The assay showed 100% interassay and intra-assay reproducibility. No cross-reactivity was observed with other respiratory viruses or common bacterial and fungal pathogens. Discussion This automated measles RT-PCR assay demonstrated high accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and reproducibility.

title: Epidemiological, Clinical, and Clinical Course Profile of Measles during the 2023–2024 Outbreak in Burkina Faso
abstract: Introduction: Measles is a widespread exanthematous febrile illness caused by a paramyxovirus of the genus Morbillivirus. The reservoir is exclusively human, and transmission occurs between humans. It is one of the most contagious infectious diseases. In Burkina Faso, measles remains a public health problem. The country experienced a major epidemic from November 2023 to August 2024. Objective: To study the epidemiological, clinical, and disease-progression profile of measles during the 2023–2024 epidemic in Burkina Faso. Methods: This descriptive cross-sectional study used data on measles cases reported in Burkina Faso from 1 November 2023 to 31 August 2024. The data were obtained from the database of the Directorate of Population Health Protection. Descriptive analysis was performed using Excel 2019. Results: A total of 7,149 measles cases were included. The overall incidence of measles was 33.28 per 100,000 inhabitants. Males were overrepresented, accounting for 51.45% of cases. The median age was 4 years. The most frequently represented age group was 0–5 years, accounting for 55.81% of cases. Most measles cases were unvaccinated, accounting for 55.31% of cases. The Hauts-Bassins and Centre regions were the most affected, with incidence rates of 67.78 and 60.17 cases per 100,000 inhabitants, respectively. The health districts of Houndé (14.69%) in the Hauts-Bassins region and Bogodogo (10.77%) in the Centre region reported the highest numbers of cases. Epidemiological weeks S08-2024 and S12-2024 recorded the highest numbers of measles cases, accounting for 7.33% and 7.32% of cases, respectively. Only 11.87% of cases had travelled within the seven days before the onset of clinical symptoms. Fever, rash, and cough were the most commonly reported symptoms, occurring in 96.87%, 95.06%, and 89.29% of cases, respectively. Laboratory confirmation was obtained in 9.79% of cases. The measles case-fatality rate during the outbreak was 0.45%. Conclusion: Measles remains a public health problem, underscoring the need to strengthen the Expanded Programme on Immunization, outbreak response, and nationwide vaccination strategies.

title: SVIR Model Analysis of Measles with Incomplete Vaccination and 1 Waning Immunity: Sidoarjo-Indonesia Case
abstract: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.

source_records.abstract: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.

abstract_zh: 麻疹仍然是印度尼西亚的重大公共卫生挑战,尤其是在疫苗接种覆盖率异质性和免疫力下降的地区。本研究开发并分析了一个针对麻疹传播的易感-接种-感染-康复(SVIR)分组模型,该模型纳入了免疫力下降的因素。基本再生数R0是通过下一代矩阵方法推导的,并且通过李雅普诺夫函数严格证明了无病平衡态和地方性平衡态的全局稳定性。模型参数是从2023年Sidoarjo市每周的监测数据中使用粒子群优化(PSO)、扩展卡尔曼滤波、最大似然估计和最小二乘法进行估计,并通过平均绝对百分比误差(MAPE)进行评估。PSO方法实现了最低的MAPE(11.17%),优于其他方法。估计的R0 = 0.668确认了无病状态。归一化敏感性分析确定疫苗效力是最关键的参数;疫苗效力下降至0 .75会使R0接近临界阈值,任何进一步的减少都会使系统进入地方性状态。这些发现强调了通过加强剂接种计划和强化疫苗接种策略保持高疫苗效力的必要性,以在区级维持麻疹的消除。

title: Optimal Control and Cost-Effectiveness Analysis of Measles Transmission
abstract: This study develops and analyzes a deterministic compartmental model for measles transmission incorporating two-dose vaccination, imperfect dose-specific vaccine protection, breakthrough infection, and nonlinear saturated incidence. The population is divided into susceptible, first-dose vaccinated, second-dose vaccinated, exposed, infectious, and recovered classes. The fundamental mathematical properties of the model are established, including positivity and boundedness of solutions. The disease-free and endemic equilibria are characterized, and the basic reproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix approach. The disease-free equilibrium is globally asymptotically stable when R0 1 the model admits a unique endemic equilibrium that is globally asymptotically stable relative to the interior of the biologically feasible region. Analytical sensitivity analysis identifies the local influence of the model parameters on R0. In particular, the saturation parameter does not enter R0, but numerical analysis shows that it can substantially affect the endemic infection level. The model is further extended to an optimal-control framework with three time-dependent, dimensionless controls representing intensified first-dose vaccination, intensified second-dose vaccination, and enhanced infectious-case removal. The existence of an optimal control is established, and Pontryagin’s Maximum Principle is used to derive the necessary optimality conditions. The resulting state–adjoint system is solved numerically using the Forward–Backward Sweep Method. Numerical simulations show that the combined optimal intervention reduces the exposed and infectious disease burdens over the finite control horizon, while sensitivity analysis demonstrates that the optimal-control profiles depend on the relative weights assigned to disease burden and intervention effort. Seven intervention combinations are subsequently compared using the model-based Average Cost-Effectiveness Ratio (ACER) and Incremental Cost-Effectiveness Ratio (ICER) measures. Under the baseline weighting scheme, first-dose vaccination alone has the smallest weighted intervention effort per case averted. After strong and extended dominance are accounted for, the incremental frontier consists of first-dose vaccination alone, first-dose vaccination combined with infectious-case removal, and the full three-control strategy. Increasing epidemiological benefit along this frontier is accompanied by increasing incremental weighted intervention effort. These results illustrate how dose-specific vaccination, nonlinear transmission, and infectious-case intervention can be integrated within a unified framework for comparing measles-control strategies while explicitly accounting for the assumptions underlying intervention effort.

The research aims to evaluate optimal control strategies for measles disease.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The population is divided into susceptible, first-dose vaccinated, second-dose vaccinated, exposed, infectious, and recovered classes. The study is conducted using a mathematical modeling approach to simulate measles transmission dynamics.
analysis.methods: The fundamental mathematical properties of the model are established, including positivity and boundedness of solutions. The disease-free and endemic equilibria are characterized, and the basic reproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix approach. The model is further extended to an optimal-control framework with three time-dependent, dimensionless controls representing intensified first-dose vaccination, intensified second-dose vaccination, and enhanced infectious-case removal.
analysis.main_results: The disease-free equilibrium is globally asymptotically stable when R0 < 1, and the model admits a unique endemic equilibrium that is globally asymptotically stable relative to the interior of the biologically feasible region. analysis.summary_en: This study develops a deterministic compartmental model for measles transmission, incorporating two-dose vaccination, imperfect vaccine protection, breakthrough infection, and nonlinear incidence. The model is extended to an optimal-control framework with three interventions: intensified first-dose vaccination, intensified second-dose vaccination, and enhanced infectious-case removal. The disease-free equilibrium is globally stable when R0 < 1, and the endemic equilibrium is stable within the biologically feasible region. Numerical simulations show that combined optimal interventions reduce disease burden, while sensitivity analysis reveals that intervention profiles depend on the relative weights of disease burden and effort. The study highlights the integration of dose-specific vaccination and infectious-case interventions within a unified framework for evaluating measles-control strategies. The findings can inform cost-effective public health interventions but are based on theoretical models and may not fully reflect real-world complexities.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究开发并分析了 麻疹 传播 的确定性隔室模型,该模型包含两剂量 疫苗接种、不完善的剂量特异性 疫苗 保护、突破性感染和非线性饱和 发病率。该研究旨在评估 麻疹 疾病的最佳控制策略。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 人群分为易感人群、第一剂疫苗接种者、第二剂疫苗接种者、暴露者、感染者和康复者。该研究是使用数学建模方法来模拟 麻疹 传播 动力学进行的。
elements_zh.methods: 建立了模型的基本数学属性,包括解的正性和有界性。对无病和地方病平衡进行了表征,并使用下一代矩阵方法推导出基本再生数 R0。该模型进一步扩展到具有三个时间依赖性无量纲控制的最优控制框架,这三个控制代表强化的第一剂量 疫苗接种、强化的第二剂量 疫苗接种 和增强的感染病例清除。
elements_zh.main_results: 当 R0 < 1 时,无病平衡是全局渐近稳定的,并且该模型承认独特的地方性平衡,相对于生物学可行区域的内部来说,该平衡是全局渐近稳定的。数值模拟表明,组合的最佳干预措施可以减少有限控制范围内的暴露疾病和传染病负担。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果说明了如何将剂量特异性 疫苗接种、非线性 传播 和感染病例干预整合到一个统一的框架中,以比较 麻疹 控制策略,同时明确考虑干预工作的假设。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以通过强调特定剂量 麻疹 和感染病例干预措施整合的重要性,为制定具有成本效益的 麻疹 控制策略提供信息。它们为评估不同 疫苗接种 方案对疾病 传播 的影响提供了基础。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于数学模型,并未考虑现实世界的复杂性,例如行为变化或空间异质性。证据来自理论分析和数值模拟,可能无法完全捕捉生物变异性。

title: Risk of Measles Outbreak in Texas School Districts: A Modeling Study.
abstract: We developed a measles transmission model for K-12 public schools in Texas at the school-district-level. We found that, between 2025 and 2030, districts in West Texas are most at risk for measles outbreaks, while districts in large metropolitan areas would likely see the largest number of cases in an outbreak.

title: Genetic characterization of production strains of measles, rubella, and mumps viruses by high-throughput sequencing
abstract: Spontaneous mutations often arise and accumulate in the genome of RNA-containing viruses, for example measles, rubella and mumps. Modern requirements for the production of vaccine products containing live vaccine viruses suggest control of the genetic stability of production strains. The method of high throughput sequencing allows to determine all mutations arisen in viral population, and to assess genetic stability of production strains. Analysis of nucleotide sequence of the genomes of seed and production strains of measles (Leningrad-16), rubella (RA27/3) and mumps (Leningrad-3) viruses, in comparison with the reference nucleotide sequences of vaccine strains genomes (submitted in the Gen-Bank database). MATERIALS AND METHODS. Production strains of vaccines (measles culture live, rubella culture live and mumps culture live) were used in this study. Whole genome sequencing was performed using the MGI DNBSEQ G-400 and Illumina NextSeq2000 genetic analyzers. When processing and analyzing the sequencing data, the following programs and tools were used: FastQC v.0.12.1, FastP v.0.23.4, BWA-MEM2 v.2.2.1, VizCoV tool. analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to assess the genetic stability of measles, rubella, and mumps production strains using high-throughput sequencing. The research focused on identifying mutations in the viral genomes that could impact vaccine immunogenicity. The study revealed that measles virus production strains had no SNPs in the H protein but showed nonsynonymous polymorphisms in the F protein, occurring in 30.0–40.9% of the viral genomes. In contrast, SNPs were found in rubella and mumps viruses, but with lower frequencies. The findings suggest that monitoring genetic stability through high-throughput sequencing is important for vaccine production. However, the study does not report limitations or evidence strength, which could affect the confidence in the results.

title: Gaps in Knowledge, Receipt, and Acceptance of Measles, Mumps, Rubella Vaccines in a National Sample of Emergency Department
abstract: Measles cases are increasing in the U.S., raising concern about gaps in adult measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccination, which is poorly captured by current surveillance. Emergency departments (EDs) act as safety nets for underserved populations and can help identify gaps in adult MMR uptake. We assessed adult MMR up-to-date status, knowledge, and willingness to receive vaccination in the ED, nationally. We conducted a cross-sectional survey of adults aged 18–64 at ten U.S. EDs from April–December 2024. Participants completed a structured survey assessing MMR knowledge, self-reported vaccination status, reasons for non-receipt, and willingness to receive MMR in the ED. Outcomes were summarized as proportions with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Multivariable logistic regression identified factors associated with not being up to date and willingness to accept vaccination. Among 2,456 participants, 25.0% (95% CI 23.3–26.7%) had not heard of the MMR vaccine, and 44.0% (42.5–46.4%) were not up to date. Factors associated with being unvaccinated included male sex (OR 2.21 [1.84–2.66]), African American (non-Hispanic) race (OR 2.27 [1.75–2.96]), Hispanic ethnicity (OR 1.98 [1.49–2.62]), non-English speakers (OR 1.53 [1.12–2.09]), and lack of primary care access (OR 1.25 [1.01–1.58]). Among those not up to date, 36.5% (33.6–39.4%) were willing to receive MMR vaccine if offered in the ED. Substantial gaps in adult MMR vaccination persist, especially among underserved populations. ED-based strategies might support targeted vaccine education and delivery during periods of increased transmission.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to assess gaps in adult measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccination, knowledge, and willingness to receive the vaccine in emergency departments (EDs). A cross-sectional survey was conducted among 2,456 adults aged 18–64 at ten U.S. EDs from April to December 2024. The survey evaluated MMR knowledge, self-reported vaccination status, reasons for non-receipt, and willingness to accept vaccination. Results showed that 25.0% of participants had not heard of the MMR vaccine, and 44.0% were not up to date. Among those not up to date, 36.5% expressed willingness to receive the vaccine if offered in the ED. The authors suggest that ED-based strategies could support targeted vaccine education and delivery during periods of increased transmission. The study highlights the importance of addressing vaccination gaps in underserved populations, particularly those with limited access to primary care. However, the cross-sectional design and reliance on self-reported data limit the confidence in the findings, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

title: Active measles surveillance in the Russian Federation: implementation principles and current challenges
abstract: From 2004 to 2006, a pilot project was carried out in 11 territories of the Russian Federation to test the method of active epidemiological surveillance, which makes it possible to identify the true number of measles patients among persons with maculopapular rash and fever, regardless of the primary diagnosis. To provide a clinical and epidemiological characterization of measles cases detected through active surveillance and to assess the quality of pre-hospital diagnosis. Materials and Methods. A retrospective analysis of data from 2017–2025 was conducted, including 1.691 epidemiological investigation forms for patients identified through active surveillance and 2.517 hospital records of inpatients. Laboratory verification was performed using immunoenzyme assay (IgM/IgG). Descriptive epidemiological and statistical methods were applied. Active surveillance annually detected missed measles cases (ranging from 1 to 743 in different years). The average age of the patients was 22.5 years. At the pre-hospital stage, measles was not recognized in 37.7 % of hospitalized patients. Over 90 % of cases in recent years exhibited a typical clinical picture, indicating low clinical awareness among physicians. Complications were registered in 38–40 % of patients, with infants under one year of age remaining the most vulnerable group. The high proportion of typical measles cases among those missed indicates systemic deficiencies in clinical diagnosis. Continuous training of medical personnel, enhanced laboratory monitoring, and maintenance of high vaccination coverage are necessary maintain measles elimination status.

title: Measles transmission and surveillance in open subcommunities
abstract: We're often in a situation where we have models of measles transmission that are stuck at a coarse population scale. This paper is about increasing their resolution or, said differently, creating consistent models for the population's subcommunities. We pay special attention to the fact that even if the full population is isolated, subcommunities are open to measles importations and related consequences of population movement. It turns out that the resolution issue can be productively framed as a constrained optimization problem, where the constraint is aggregation to the coarse model. That mathematical scaffolding allows us to make epidemiologically motivated approximations concentrated at the large population scale, where they're more valid, which leaves the estimates at the fine subcommunity scale atypically unstructured. We develop the idea in the context of the pre-vaccination-era 60 city UK dataset, building transmission models for all 60 cities. We find that they have intuitive seasonality, volatility, and importation elements, but that they depend on nontrivial dynamics in their case reporting probabilities. Potential interpretations of those surveillance processes are discussed in some detail, and we also describe how they influence inference on the balance between competing cryptic transmission and transient elimination dynamics.

The study aims to improve the resolution of these models to better capture the complexities of measles spread within specific subcommunities.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focuses on the pre-vaccination-era 60 city UK dataset, examining measles transmission across all 60 cities to understand how subcommunities interact with measles importations and population movement. The analysis is conducted within this historical dataset to explore the dynamics of disease spread.
analysis.methods: The research employs mathematical modeling to frame the resolution issue as a constrained optimization problem, where the constraint is the aggregation to the coarse model. This approach allows for the development of epidemiologically motivated approximations at the large population scale, while maintaining the focus on subcommunity-specific dynamics.
analysis.main_results: The models reveal that measles transmission in subcommunities exhibits intuitive seasonality, volatility, and importation elements, but they also depend on nontrivial dynamics in their case reporting probabilities. These findings highlight the complexity of modeling measles at a finer scale.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these results as demonstrating the importance of considering subcommunity-specific dynamics in measles modeling, which can provide more accurate insights into transmission patterns. This approach is novel in its application to historical data and its focus on subcommunity resolution.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform improved surveillance and modeling strategies for measles in subcommunities, which may enhance public health interventions and risk assessments. They also provide insights into the role of case reporting in shaping epidemiological understanding.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to historical data from the pre-vaccination era, which may not fully represent current transmission dynamics. The evidence is moderate, as the analysis is based on a single dataset and relies on mathematical modeling assumptions.

analysis.summary_en: This paper explores the need for more detailed measles transmission models at the subcommunity level, as existing models are limited to a coarse population scale. The study uses a constrained optimization framework to improve resolution, focusing on the UK's pre-vaccination-era 60 city dataset. Results show that subcommunity measles transmission has seasonality, volatility, and importation elements, but is influenced by nontrivial case reporting dynamics. The authors interpret these findings as highlighting the importance of subcommunity-specific modeling for accurate epidemiological insights. The study's implications include better surveillance and risk assessment strategies for measles in open subcommunities. However, the reliance on historical data and mathematical modeling assumptions limits the strength of the evidence, which is considered moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本文解决了在子社区层面对 麻疹 传播 更详细模型的需求,因为现有模型仅限于粗略的人口规模。该研究旨在提高这些模型的分辨率,以更好地捕捉 麻疹 在特定子社区内传播的复杂性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究重点关注 疫苗接种 时代之前的 60 个英国城市数据集,检查所有 60 个城市的 麻疹 传播,以了解子社区如何与 麻疹 输入和人口流动相互作用。该分析是在这个历史数据集中进行的,以探索疾病传播的动态。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用数学建模将解决问题框架为约束优化问题,其中约束是粗模型的聚合。这种方法允许在大规模人口规模上开发流行病学驱动的近似值,同时保持对亚社区特定动态的关注。
elements_zh.main_results: 这些模型表明,子社区中的 麻疹 传播 表现出直观的季节性、波动性和进口元素,但它们也依赖于病例报告概率中的重要动态。这些发现凸显了在更精细的尺度上建模 麻疹 的复杂性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些结果解释为证明了在 麻疹 建模中考虑子社区特定动态的重要性,这可以为 传播 模式提供更准确的见解。这种方法的新颖之处在于它对历史数据的应用以及对子社区解决方案的关注。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为改进 麻疹 和子社区中 麻疹 的建模策略提供信息,这可能会加强公共卫生干预和风险评估。它们还深入探讨了病例报告在形成流行病学理解方面的作用。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于 疫苗接种 时代之前的历史数据,可能无法完全代表当前的 传播 动态。证据是中等的,因为分析基于单个数据集并依赖于数学建模假设。

title_zh: 开放子社区中的 麻疹 传播 和 监测
source_body_en: We're often in a situation where we have models of measles transmission that are stuck at a coarse population scale. This paper is about increasing their resolution or, said differently, creating consistent models for the population's subcommunities. We pay special attention to the fact that even if the full population is isolated, subcommunities are open to measles importations and related consequences of population movement. It turns out that the resolution issue can be productively framed as a constrained optimization problem, where the constraint is aggregation to the coarse model. That mathematical scaffolding allows us to make epidemiologically motivated approximations concentrated at the large population scale, where they're more valid, which leaves the estimates at the fine subcommunity scale atypically unstructured. We develop the idea in the context of the pre-vaccination-era 60 city UK dataset, building transmission models for all 60 cities. We find that they have intuitive seasonality, volatility, and importation elements, but that they depend on nontrivial dynamics in their case reporting probabilities. Potential interpretations of those surveillance processes are discussed in some detail, and we also describe how they influence inference on the balance between competing cryptic transmission and transient elimination dynamics.
abstract_zh: 我们经常遇到这样的情况:我们的 麻疹 传播 模型陷入了粗略的人口规模。本文旨在提高其分辨率,或者换句话说,为人口的子社区创建一致的模型。我们特别注意这样一个事实:即使全部人口被隔离,子社区也对 麻疹 输入和人口流动的相关后果开放。事实证明,解决问题可以有效地构建为约束优化问题,其中约束是对粗略模型的聚合。这种数学框架使我们能够在大人口规模上进行流行病学驱动的近似,在这种情况下它们更有效,这使得精细子社区规模的估计变得非典型的非结构化。我们在 疫苗接种 时代之前的英国 60 个城市数据集的背景下开发了这个想法,为所有 60 个城市构建了 传播 模型。我们发现它们具有直观的季节性、波动性和进口元素,但它们依赖于病例报告概率的重要动态。我们详细讨论了这些 监测 过程的潜在解释,并且我们还描述了它们如何影响对竞争性神秘 传播 和瞬态消除动力学之间的平衡的推断。

title: Sốt phát ban nghi sởi tại Nghệ An năm 2024–2025: Phân bố theo nhóm tuổi nguy cơ và địa bàn xã mới từ số liệu giám sát Suspected Measles Cases in Nghe An during 2024–2025: A descriptive analysis of age group and new communes based on surveillance data
abstract: Năm 2024-2025, Nghệ An ghi nhận số trường hợp SPB nghi sởi cao vượt mức so với trung bình giai đoạn 2019-2023. Nghiên cứu loạt ca bệnh hồi cứu nhằm mô tả đặc điểm dịch tễ, tập trung vào sự phân bố theo thời gian, nhóm tuổi và địa bàn xã mới thông qua hệ thống giám sát từ 01/2024 - 12/2025. Kết quả ghi nhận 4.531 ca SPB nghi sởi, (từ 0-81 tuổi), tập trung ở trẻ<5 tuổi (nhóm từ 2- <5 tuổi chiếm tỷ trọng cao nhất 27,8%). Nhóm ≥ 5 tuổi (chiếm 40,5%), cho thấy bệnh đã xuất hiện nhiều ở các nhóm tuổi lớn hơn, phản ánh sự tồn tại của khoảng trống miễn dịch trong cộng đồng. 588/712 ca sởi xét nghiệm dương tính (82,6%) cho thấy 100% có sốt, phát ban, 99,5% biến chứng viêm phổi và 86,7% chưa tiêm vắc xin sởi. Các xã có tỷ lệ mắc cao nhất chủ yếu ở vùng cao, biên giới. Theo thời gian, số mắc tăng dần vào nửa cuối năm 2024 và đạt đỉnh vào tháng 3/2025 (1.296 trường hợp), sau đó giảm dần. Cần ưu tiên nguồn lực dự phòng cho các xã khó khăn, đẩy mạnh truyền thông nguy cơ phù hợp với đặc điểm văn hoá, ngôn ngữ của đồng bào dân tộc thiểu số về lợi ích của vắc-xin, vận động người dân tham gia tiêm chủng, đồng thời duy trì hệ thống dữ liệu giám sát chặt chẽ.

Kết quả ghi nhận 4.531 ca SPB nghi sởi, (từ 0-81 tuổi), tập trung ở trẻ<5 tuổi (nhóm từ 2- <5 tuổi chiếm tỷ trọng cao nhất 27,8%). Nhóm ≥ 5 tuổi (chiếm 40,5%), cho thấy bệnh đã xuất hiện nhiều ở các nhóm tuổi lớn hơn, phản ánh sự tồn tại của khoảng trống miễn dịch trong cộng đồng. 588/712 ca sởi xét nghiệm dương tính (82,6%) cho thấy 100% có sốt, phát ban, 99,5% biến chứng viêm phổi và 86,7% chưa tiêm vắc xin sởi. Các xã có tỷ lệ mắc cao nhất chủ yếu ở vùng cao, biên giới. Theo thời gian, số mắc tăng dần vào nửa cuối năm 2024 và đạt đỉnh vào tháng 3/2025 (1.296 trường hợp), sau đó giảm dần. Cần ưu tiên nguồn lực dự phòng cho các xã khó khăn, đẩy mạnh truyền thông nguy cơ phù hợp với đặc điểm văn hoá, ngôn ngữ của đồng bào dân tộc thiểu số về lợi ích của vắc-xin, vận động người dân tham gia tiêm chủng, đồng thời duy trì hệ thống dữ liệu giám sát chặt chẽ.

title_original: Sốt phát ban nghi sởi tại Nghệ An năm 2024–2025: Phân bố theo nhóm tuổi nguy cơ và địa bàn xã mới từ số liệu giám sát Suspected Measles Cases in Nghe An during 2024–2025: A descriptive analysis of age group and new communes based on surveillance data

analysis.research_question_and_background: Năm 2024–2025, Nghệ An ghi nhận số trường hợp sốt phát ban nghi sởi cao vượt mức so với trung bình giai đoạn 2019–2023. Nghiên cứu này nhằm mô tả đặc điểm dịch tễ của bệnh, tập trung vào sự phân bố theo thời gian, nhóm tuổi và địa bàn xã mới.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Nghiên cứu loạt ca bệnh hồi cứu được thực hiện tại Nghệ An từ 01/2024 đến 12/2025, tập trung vào các ca bệnh sốt phát ban nghi sởi được ghi nhận qua hệ thống giám sát. Tổng cộng có 4.531 ca được ghi nhận, bao gồm cả trẻ em dưới 5 tuổi và người lớn hơn.
analysis.methods: Kết quả được thu thập từ hệ thống giám sát, mô tả phân bố theo nhóm tuổi và địa bàn xã. Các ca bệnh được phân loại dựa trên lứa tuổi và khu vực địa lý, đồng thời xác định tỷ lệ mắc bệnh theo thời gian.
analysis.main_results: Trong tổng số 4.531 ca SPB nghi sởi, trẻ dưới 5 tuổi chiếm tỷ trọng cao nhất (27,8%), trong khi nhóm ≥ 5 tuổi chiếm 40,5%. Số ca mắc tăng dần vào nửa cuối năm 2024 và đạt đỉnh vào tháng 3/2025 (1.296 trường hợp), sau đó giảm dần.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Sự gia tăng số ca mắc ở các nhóm tuổi lớn hơn cho thấy sự tồn tại của khoảng trống miễn dịch trong cộng đồng, điều này có thể phản ánh sự suy giảm tỷ lệ tiêm chủng. Các xã có tỷ lệ mắc cao nhất chủ yếu ở vùng cao và biên giới.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Kết quả cho thấy cần ưu tiên nguồn lực dự phòng cho các xã có tỷ lệ mắc cao, đặc biệt là ở vùng cao và biên giới, đồng thời đẩy mạnh truyền thông về lợi ích của vắc-xin sởi.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Nghiên cứu dựa trên dữ liệu giám sát, không có thông tin chi tiết về các phương pháp xét nghiệm hoặc phân tích thống kê. Tuy nhiên, dữ liệu được cung cấp có thể hỗ trợ đánh giá dịch tễ học một cách chính xác.

analysis.summary_en: The study analyzed measles-like cases in Nghe An during 2024–2025, revealing a higher incidence compared to 2019–2023. It focused on the distribution of cases by age group and new communes, identifying a significant proportion in children under 5 and a rising trend in late 2024. The findings highlight the presence of immune gaps in the population and emphasize the need for targeted prevention in high-risk areas. The research underscores the importance of strengthening surveillance and promoting vaccination, particularly among ethnic minority communities. However, the study is limited to descriptive analysis based on surveillance data without detailed statistical or laboratory methods.

title: Đặc điểm dịch tễ học bệnh sởi và xác định các cụm nguy cơ cao mắc bệnh theo không gian–thời gian bằng phương pháp thống kê quét tại tỉnh Đắk Nông, năm 2024–2025 The epidemiological characteristics and the application of scan statistics to identify highrisk space–time clusters of the measles outbreak in Dak Nong province, 2024–2025
abstract: Nghiên cứu mô tả đặc điểm dịch tễ học và xác định các cụm nguy cơ cao mắc bệnh theo không gian – thờigian của các trường hợp sốt phát ban nghi sởi và sởi xác định tại Đắk Nông năm 2024 – 2025. Nghiên cứucắt ngang hồi cứu dựa trên số liệu giám sát, kết hợp phân tích không gian – thời gian. Có 852/869 trườnghợp đủ thông tin được đưa vào phân tích. Thống kê quét được thực hiện bằng phần mềm SaTScan vớimô hình Poisson rời rạc, cửa sổ không gian tối đa 10% dân số nguy cơ, cửa sổ thời gian tối đa 21 ngàyvà 9.999 lần mô phỏng Monte Carlo. Dịch sởi diễn biến thành hai đợt tăng chính vào nửa cuối 2024 vàđầu 2025, 68,2% trường hợp ghi nhận trong năm 2025. Trẻ dưới 15 tuổi chiếm 89,2%, trong đó nhóm 18tháng đến 5 tuổi chiếm tỷ lệ cao nhất (32,0%). Người Kinh, Mông và Mnông lần lượt chiếm 46,8%, 30,9%và 11,6%. Hơn 70% xã/phường có tỷ suất mắc từ 50/100.000 dân trở lên. Phân tích SaTScan xác định19 cụm nguy cơ cao có ý nghĩa thống kê, RR dao động từ 5,32 đến 177,93, chủ yếu xuất hiện từ tháng8/2024 đến tháng 4/2025, phù hợp với hai đợt tăng chính của dịch. Cụm nổi bật nhất tại Đắk Ngo từ ngày10–30/9/2024, có 76 trường hợp, RR = 177,93 và p < 0,0001. Kết quả cho thấy các trường hợp bệnh phânbố không đồng đều theo không gian và thời gian. SaTScan hỗ trợ xác định địa bàn và thời điểm cần ưu tiênhỗ trợ trong giám sát chủ động, điều tra ổ dịch, rà soát tiêm chủng và triển khai tiêm vét.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to describe the epidemiological characteristics and identify high-risk space-time clusters of measles outbreaks in Dak Nong province during 2024–2025. It employed a cross-sectional retrospective study design using surveillance data combined with space-time scan analysis. The methods included the use of SaTScan software with a discrete Poisson model, a spatial window of up to 10% of the at-risk population, a temporal window of up to 21 days, and 9,999 Monte Carlo simulations. The main results showed that measles outbreaks occurred in two main waves towards the end of 2024 and the beginning of 2025, with 68.2% of cases recorded in 2025. The analysis identified 19 statistically significant high-risk clusters, with relative risks ranging from 5.32 to 177.93, primarily appearing from August 2024 to April 2025, aligning with the two main outbreak waves. The most prominent cluster was in Dak Nong from September 10–30, 2024, with 76 cases, RR = 177.93, and p < 0.0001. The findings indicate uneven spatial and temporal distribution of measles cases. SaTScan results support targeted efforts in active surveillance, outbreak investigation, vaccination review, and mass vaccination campaigns. The evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of reported limitations.

elements_en.scope_and_question: This review focuses on long-term survival (≥2 years) in subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE), a progressive and often fatal disorder caused by the measles virus. The central question is to characterize prolonged survivors, remission, stabilization, and identify determinants of favorable outcomes.
elements_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: A systematic review was conducted according to PRISMA 2020 guidelines. The review aimed to analyze long-term survival, remission, and stabilization in SSPE cases, with eligibility restricted to confirmed SSPE cases. Individual patient analysis was limited to cases with ≥2 years of follow-up.
elements_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Analysis of 77 patients showed that survival beyond 2 years is achievable but highly variable. The survival distribution indicated that 44.2% of patients survived between 2 to [incomplete data].
elements_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evidence is limited by incomplete survival distribution data, which prevents a full understanding of long-term outcomes. There is no detailed discussion on the determinants of favorable outcomes or the mechanisms underlying survival.
elements_en.research_and_practice_implications: Further research is needed to complete the survival distribution analysis and to explore the factors contributing to favorable outcomes in SSPE. This could inform better surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment strategies for prolonged survivors.

title: An age-stratified mathematical model to inform optimal measles vaccination strategies
abstract: Background: Measles remains a significant global public health threat despite the availability of an effective vaccine. WHO recommends the first measles vaccine dose at 9–12 months of age, balancing maternal antibody interference and immune system maturity. However, infants younger than 9 months remain highly vulnerable, especially in regions with high transmission and low herd immunity. Methods: This study introduces an age-stratified, multi-compartmental model of measles transmission that captures infections in unvaccinated infants by explicitly modelling maternal immunity decay and early infection risks. We prove the model’s positivity and derive an analytical expression for the instantaneous replacement number. For a non-age-stratified version, we analyze equilibrium points and their stability. We also conducted a global sensitivity analysis of the model parameters with respect to the aggregate incidence of measles over 30 years. Further, using a bootstrap algorithm, critical parameters and age-specific transmission rates are identified by fitting the model to yearly incidence data from six measles-prevalent countries. Results: Transmission among children aged 1–5 years had the strongest positive association with cumulative measles incidence, whereas MCV1 efficacy and coverage had the strongest negative associations. Estimated instantaneous replacement numbers fluctuated between 0.85 and 1.15 during 2020–2023. Under the model assumptions, scenarios including MCV0 produced larger reductions in projected measles incidence than those without MCV0. The proposed model provides a framework for evaluating hypothetical vaccination scenarios, including different routine and supplementary dose schedules. Conclusions: The study estimates the relative number of cases averted and projects elimination timelines for several hypothetical scenarios, highlighting that combining routine and supplementary immunizations with alternative assumptions such as early measles vaccination may be highly effective.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管存在有效的 疫苗,但 麻疹 仍然是一个重大的全球公共卫生威胁。世卫组织建议在 9-12 个月龄时首次注射 麻疹 疫苗,以平衡母体抗体干扰和免疫系统成熟度。然而,9 个月以下的婴儿仍然非常脆弱,特别是在 传播 高且群体免疫力低的地区。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究引入了 麻疹 传播 的年龄分层、多室模型,该模型通过明确模拟母体免疫力衰退和早期感染风险来捕获未接种疫苗的婴儿的感染情况。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用年龄分层、多室方法对 麻疹 传播 进行建模,分析平衡点及其稳定性,并对模型参数进行全局敏感性分析。该模型使用引导算法拟合来自六个 麻疹 流行国家的年度 发病率 数据。
elements_zh.main_results: 1-5 岁儿童中的 传播 与累积 麻疹 发病率 具有最强的正相关性,而 MCV1 疗效和覆盖率具有最强的负相关性。2020 年至 2023 年期间估计瞬时更换数量在 0.85 至 1.15 之间波动。在模型假设下,包含 MCV0 的场景比不包含 MCV0 的场景产生的预计 麻疹 发病率 的减少幅度更大。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究估计了避免病例的相对数量,并预测了几种假设情况下的消除时间表,强调将常规免疫和补充免疫与早期 麻疹 疫苗接种 等替代假设相结合可能非常有效。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 所提出的模型提供了一个用于评估假设的 疫苗接种 场景的框架,包括不同的常规和补充剂量方案,并且可以告知最佳的 麻疹 疫苗接种 策略,以减少 发病率 并实现消除。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖于模型假设以及模型参数与六个国家数据的拟合,这可能无法推广到所有地区。证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 背景:尽管存在有效的 麻疹,但 麻疹 仍然是一个重大的全球公共卫生威胁。世卫组织建议在 9-12 个月龄时首次注射 麻疹 疫苗,以平衡母体抗体干扰和免疫系统成熟度。然而,9 个月以下的婴儿仍然非常脆弱,特别是在 传播 高且群体免疫力低的地区。方法:本研究引入了 麻疹 传播 的年龄分层、多室模型,该模型通过明确模拟母体免疫力衰退和早期感染风险来捕获未接种疫苗的婴儿的感染。我们证明了模型的正性并推导出瞬时替换数的解析表达式。对于非年龄分层版本,我们分析平衡点及其稳定性。我们还对模型参数相对于 30 年来 麻疹 的总和 发病率 进行了全局敏感性分析。此外,使用引导算法,通过将模型拟合到六个 麻疹 流行国家的年度 发病率 数据来确定关键参数和特定年龄的 传播 率。结果:1-5岁儿童中的传播与累积麻疹 发病率具有最强的正相关性,而MCV1疗效和覆盖率具有最强的负相关性。2020 年至 2023 年期间估计瞬时更换数量在 0.85 至 1.15 之间波动。在模型假设下,包含 MCV0 的场景比不包含 MCV0 的场景产生的预计 麻疹 发病率 的减少幅度更大。所提出的模型提供了一个用于评估假设的 疫苗接种 场景的框架,包括不同的常规和补充剂量方案。结论:该研究估计了避免病例的相对数量,并预测了几种假设情况下的消除时间表,强调将常规免疫和补充免疫与早期 麻疹 疫苗接种 等替代假设相结合可能非常有效。

title: Measles subacute sclerosing panencephalitis in children: past and present
abstract: Эпидемиологическая ситуация по кори оставалась нестабильной в последние годы в России и в ряде других стран, сопровождалась подъемом заболеваемости в постковидном периоде, особенно в 2024 г. среди детей до 1 года, что является фактором риска развития крайней тяжелого и малокурабельного осложнения — коревого подострого склерозирующего панэнцефалита, как правило, манифестирующего неврологическими симптомами через 5–7 лет после перенесенной кори. Проведен анализ описательных и систематических научных литературных обзоров, а также других зарубежных и российских публикаций преимущественно за последние 10 лет, посвященных коревому подострому склерозирующему панэнцефалиту, вопросам этиологии, эпидемиологии, патогенеза и рисков развития после перенесенной кори, характерным клиническим симптомам, диагностическим критериям, а также методам лабораторной и инструментальной диагностики (электроэнцефалографии и магнитно-резонансная томографии). Представлены результаты международных исследований по оценке клинической эффективности различных схем терапии коревого подострого склерозирующего панэнцефалита у детей.
journal: Rossiyskiy Vestnik Perinatologii i Pediatrii (Russian Bulletin of Perinatology and Pediatrics)

source_records.abstract: Эпидемиологическая ситуация по кори оставалась нестабильной в последние годы в России и в ряде других стран, сопровождалась подъемом заболеваемости в постковидном периоде, особенно в 2024 г. среди детей до 1 года, что является фактором риска развития крайней тяжелого и малокурабельного осложнения — коревого подострого склерозирующего панэнцефалита, как правило, манифестирующего неврологическими симптомами через 5–7 лет после перенесенной кори. Проведен анализ описательных и систематических научных литературных обзоров, а также других зарубежных и российских публикаций преимущественно за последние 10 лет, посвященных коревому подострому склерозирующему панэнцефалиту, вопросам этиологии, эпидемиологии, патогенеза и рисков развития после перенесенной кори, характерным клиническим симптомам, диагностическим критериям, а также методам лабораторной и инструментальной диагностики (электроэнцефалографии и магнитно-резонансная томографии). Представлены результаты международных исследований по оценке клинической эффективности различных схем терапии коревого подострого склерозирующего панэнцефалита у детей.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the ongoing instability of measles epidemiology in Russia and other countries, particularly the rise in post-measles complications such as subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) among young children, which often manifests with neurological symptoms years after infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed descriptive and systematic scientific literature reviews, as well as other foreign and Russian publications from the last 10 years, focusing on SSPE, its etiology, epidemiology, pathogenesis, and risk factors following measles infection, particularly in children under one year of age.
analysis.methods: The research involved a review of international studies assessing the clinical effectiveness of various treatment regimens for SSPE in children, including laboratory and instrumental diagnostic methods such as electroencephalography and magnetic resonance imaging.
analysis.main_results: The study presented results from international research on the clinical effectiveness of different treatment schemes for SSPE in children, highlighting the challenges in managing this severe complication.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as emphasizing the need for improved surveillance and early intervention strategies for SSPE, particularly in young children, and noted the novelty of the study in compiling recent data on this rare but severe condition.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public health strategies for measles surveillance and the development of targeted interventions to manage SSPE in children, especially in regions with unstable measles epidemiology.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on existing literature reviews and does not include original data, resulting in moderate evidence strength for the clinical effectiveness of treatment regimens for SSPE.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the ongoing instability of measles epidemiology in Russia and other countries, highlighting the increased incidence of post-measles complications such as subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) among children under one year of age. The research reviews descriptive and systematic literature from the past decade, focusing on SSPE's etiology, epidemiology, and clinical management. It presents results from international studies on the effectiveness of various treatment regimens for SSPE, emphasizing the need for improved surveillance and early intervention. The authors interpret these findings as underscoring the importance of monitoring and managing SSPE, particularly in young children, and note the novelty of compiling recent data on this rare condition. The study's reliance on existing literature limits its evidence strength, providing moderate confidence in its conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决俄罗斯和其他国家 麻疹 流行病学 持续不稳定的问题,特别是 麻疹 后并发症的增加,例如幼儿中的 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 (SSPE),这些并发症通常在感染数年后出现神经系统症状。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了描述性和系统性的科学文献综述以及过去 10 年的其他外国和俄罗斯出版物,重点关注 SSPE、其病因、流行病学、发病机制 以及 麻疹 感染后的危险因素,特别是在一岁以下儿童中。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究回顾了评估各种 治疗 方案对儿童 SSPE 的临床有效性的国际研究,包括实验室和仪器诊断方法,如脑电图和磁共振成像。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究介绍了不同 治疗 方案治疗儿童 SSPE 临床有效性的国际研究结果,强调了处理这种严重并发症的挑战。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为强调需要改进 监测 和 SSPE 的早期干预策略,尤其是幼儿,并指出该研究在汇编有关这种罕见但严重的疾病的最新数据方面的新颖性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为 麻疹 麻疹 监测 的公共卫生策略以及制定有针对性的干预措施来管理儿童 SSPE 提供信息,特别是在 麻疹 流行病学 不稳定的地区。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究由于依赖现有文献综述而受到限制,并且不包括原始数据,导致 治疗 方案治疗 SSPE 临床有效性的证据强度中等。

title: Sự lan truyền dịch sởi theo không gian - thời gian và một số yếu tố liên quan tại Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh năm 2024–2025 Spatio-temporal spread of the measles epidemic and some related factors in Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC) during the 2024–2025 period
abstract: Sởi là bệnh truyền nhiễm có khả năng lây lan rất cao, đặc biệt tại khu vực đông dân. Nghiên cứu mô tảsự lan truyền dịch sởi theo không gian - thời gian và một số yếu tố liên quan tại thành phố Hồ Chí Minh(TPHCM) giai đoạn 2024–2025 và các yếu tố nguy cơ.
