analysis.research_question_and_background: Nghiên cứu nhằm xác định đặc điểm lan truyền dịch sởi theo không gian - thời gian và các yếu tố liên quan tại Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh năm 2024–2025, đặc biệt là các yếu tố nguy cơ ảnh hưởng đến tỷ lệ mắc bệnh.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Nghiên cứu mô tả hồi cứu 9.699 ca sởi có địa chỉ tại TPHCM, khởi phát từ 1/1/2024 đến 31/7/2025, được trích từ hệ thống quản lý bệnh truyền nhiễm. Dịch sởi bắt đầu từ các cửa ngõ giáp ranh tỉnh phía Tây–Tây Nam và lan đa hướng vào nội thành trước khi thoái lui.
analysis.methods: Nghiên cứu sử dụng phần mềm QGIS để mô tả xu hướng thay đổi tỷ lệ mắc theo không gian - thời gian. Mối liên quan giữa tỷ lệ mắc và các yếu tố nguy cơ được kiểm tra bằng hồi quy nhị thức âm và hồi quy tuyến tính.
analysis.main_results: Tỷ suất mắc sởi nhóm 6-<9 tháng cao nhất với 3745 ca/100.000 dân. Có sự tương quan thuận giữa tỷ lệ mắc và số cơ sở giáo dục theo địa phương (r = 0,73, p < 0,001). Các xã, phường có khu công nghiệp (KCN) có tỷ suất mắc sởi cao gấp 11,96 lần so với các xã, phường không có KCN (IRR= 11,96; CI 95%: 4,73 - 37,27).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Nghiên cứu xác định các khu vực có KCN và trường học là những yếu tố nguy cơ chính ảnh hưởng đến tỷ lệ mắc sởi, đồng thời mô tả đặc điểm lan truyền dịch bệnh theo không gian - thời gian tại TPHCM.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Kết quả có thể hỗ trợ việc thiết kế mô hình giám sát dịch sởi theo không gian, ưu tiên các điểm nóng có nhiều yếu tố làm tăng nguy cơ như KCN và trường học để triển khai các biện pháp phòng ngừa hiệu quả.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Nghiên cứu dựa trên dữ liệu từ hệ thống quản lý bệnh truyền nhiễm, có thể bị giới hạn bởi độ chính xác của dữ liệu thu thập. Tuy nhiên, các kết quả được hỗ trợ bởi phân tích thống kê và mô hình không gian, cho thấy mức độ tin cậy cao.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the spatio-temporal spread of measles in Ho Chi Minh City during 2024–2025 and identifies related risk factors. It reports that the highest measles incidence was observed in the 6-<9 month age group, with 3745 cases per 100,000 people. A strong positive correlation was found between measles incidence and the number of educational institutions (r = 0.73, p < 0.001). Areas with industrial zones had 11.96 times higher incidence compared to those without (IRR=11.96; CI 95%: 4.73–37.27). The outbreak started at the western and southwestern border areas and spread in multiple directions before reaching the city center. The findings suggest that spatial surveillance models should prioritize high-risk areas with industrial zones and educational institutions for effective measles prevention strategies. The study is based on data from the infectious disease management system and uses QGIS and statistical regression methods for analysis, indicating high confidence in the results.

analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Kết quả có thể hỗ trợ việc thiết kế mô hình giám sát dịch sởi theo không gian, ưu tiên các điểm nóng có nhiều yếu tố làm tăng nguy cơ như KCN và trường học để triển khai các biện pháp phòng ngừa hiệu quả.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Nghiên cứu dựa trên dữ liệu từ hệ thống quản lý bệnh truyền nhiễm, có thể bị giới hạn bởi độ chính xác của dữ liệu thu thập. Tuy nhiên, các kết quả được hỗ trợ bởi phân tích thống kê và mô hình không gian, cho thấy mức độ tin cậy cao.

title_zh: Sự lan truyền dịch sởi theo không gian - thời gian và một số yếu tố liên quan tại Thành phố Hồ Chi Minh năm 2024–2025 2024-2025年期间胡志明市(HCMC)麻疹疫情及一些相关因素
source_body_en: Sởi là bệnh truyền nhiễm có khả năng lây lan rất cao, đặc biệt tại khu vực đông dân. Nghiên cứu mô tảsự lan truyền dịch sởi theo không gian - thời gian và một số yếu tố liên quan tại thành phố Hồ Chí Minh(TPHCM) giai đoạn 2024–2025 và các yếu tố nguy cơ. Nghiên cứu mô tả hồi cứu 9.699 ca sởi có địa chỉtại TPHCM, khởi phát từ 1/1/2024 đến 31/7/2025, trích từ hệ thống quản lý bệnh truyền nhiễm. Mô tả xuhướng thay đổi tỷ lệ mắc theo không gian-thời gian bằng QGIS. Xét mối liên quan bằng hồi quy nhị thức âmvà hồi quy tuyến tính. Tỷ suất mắc sởi nhóm 6-<9 tháng cao nhất với 3745 ca/100.000 dân. Dịch khởi pháttừ cửa ngõ giáp ranh tỉnh phía Tây–Tây Nam, có xu hướng lan đa hướng, rồi vào nội thành trước khi thoáilui. Có sự tương quan thuận giữa tỷ lệ mắc và số cơ sở giáo dục theo địa phương (r = 0,73, p < 0,001).Các xã, phường có KCN có tỷ suất mắc sởi cao gấp 11,96 lần so với các xã, phường không có KCN (IRR= 11,96; CI 95%: 4,73 - 37,27). Dịch sởi tại TPHCM 2024–2025 có đặc điểm khởi phát từ cửa ngõ có KCN,gia tăng đa hướng trước khi vào trung tâm. Mô hình giám sát theo không gian nên ưu tiên các điểm nóngcó nhiều yếu tố làm tăng nguy cơ (KCN, trường học).

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: Nghiên cứu nhằm xác định đặc điểm lan truyền dịch sởi theo không gian - thời gian và các yếu tố liên quan tại Thành胡志明市2024年至2025年,将在2024年至2025年期间实现这一目标。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究使用QGIS软件描述空间-时间发病率的变化趋势。通过负二项回归和线性回归分析发病率与风险因素之间的关系。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: Nghiên cứu xác định các khu vực có KCN và trường học là những yếu tố nguy cơ chính ảnh hưởng đến tỷ lệ mắc sởi,请注意,不要将其视为 TPHCM。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果有助于设计基于空间的麻疹疫情监测模型,优先考虑具有多种风险因素(如工业区和学校)的热点区域,以有效实施预防措施。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于传染病管理系统的数据,可能受到数据收集准确性的限制。然而,研究结果得到了统计分析和空间模型的支持,显示出较高的可信度。

title: Đặc điểm dịch tễ bệnh sởi và một số yếu tố liên quan đến biến chứng của bệnh tại tỉnh Bình Định năm 2024 Epidemiological characteristics of measles and some factors related to measles complications in Binh Dinh province in 2024
abstract: Bệnh sởi tái bùng phát tại Bình Định năm 2024 sau đợt dịch gần nhất năm 2019. Nghiên cứu nhằm môtả đặc điểm dịch tễ bệnh sởi và một số yếu tố liên quan đến biến chứng sởi. Nghiên cứu cắt ngang, hồicứu số liệu ca bệnh sởi (gồm ca nghi ngờ và ca xác định phòng xét nghiệm) khởi phát trong năm 2024tại Bình Định trên hệ thống giám sát sởi-rubella. Sử dụng mô tả tần số, tỷ lệ; phân tích đơn biến (sử dụngOR, 95% CI) xác định mối liên quan đến biến chứng bệnh sởi (có ít nhất 1 biến chứng tiêu chảy, viêm phổi,viêm tai giữa...). Kết quả năm 2024, tỉnh Bình Định ghi nhận 198 ca sởi (gấp 11,4 lần trung bình giai đoạn2019-2023), không ca tử vong. Ca mắc đạt đỉnh ở tuần 45 (25 ca). Bệnh ghi nhận cao nhất ở Quy Nhơn(57,7%, 109/198) và nhóm từ 18 tháng đến 5 tuổi (27,8%, 55/198). 71,2% (141/198) ca bệnh chưa tiêm/không rõ tiền sử tiêm vắc xin sởi. 35,4% (70/198) ca bệnh có ít nhất 1 biến chứng. Yếu tố liên quan biếnchứng: Ca bệnh dưới 5 tuổi (OR 2,1), chưa tiêm đủ 2 mũi vắc xin sởi (OR 3,6) và tiền sử nhập viện điều trịbệnh khác trước khởi phát 3 tuần (OR 3,2). Cần triển khai chiến dịch tiêm bổ sung và đánh giá miễn dịchđối với vắc xin sởi.

Cần triển khai chiến dịch tiêm bổ sung và đánh giá miễn dịchđối với vắc xin sởi.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述2024年平定省麻疹的流行病学特征及与麻疹并发症相关的因素。麻疹在2024年平定省再次暴发,继2019年最近一次疫情之后。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项横断面研究,通过麻疹-风疹监测系统收集了2024年平定省麻疹病例(包括疑似病例和实验室确诊病例)的数据。研究中共记录了198例麻疹病例。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究采用频率描述和比率分析,结合单变量分析来确定麻疹病例与并发症之间的关系。使用OR(比值比)和95% CI(95%置信区间)等指标进行评估。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 2024 年 2024 年,我们将迎来新的一年。yếu tố nguy cơ liên quan đến biến chứng như độ tuổi dưới 5,chưa tiêm đủ 2 mũi vắc xin sởi và tiền sử 3 小时后,您将收到通知。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本研究为平定省麻疹的流行病学特征和相关风险因素提供了重要信息,有助于在社区中开展麻疹疫苗补充接种活动和评估疫苗免疫应答。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于监测系统的数据,可能受到数据收集准确性的限制。然而,研究结果得到了统计分析和OR比率的支持,显示出较高的可信度。

title: Một số đặc điểm dịch tễ học bệnh sởi tại Thanh Hoá, năm 2024-2025 Epidemiological characteristics of measles in Thanh Hoa province, 2024–2025
abstract: Giai đoạn 2024–2025, số ca mắc sởi tăng mạnh tại tỉnh Thanh Hóa, tập trung ở nhóm chưa đến độ tuổitiêm chủng hoặc chưa được tiêm đầy đủ. Nghiên cứu nhằm mô tả một số đặc điểm dịch tễ học của cáctrường hợp mắc sởi tại Thanh Hóa. Thiết kế mô tả hồi cứu loạt ca bệnh được áp dụng với 1.587 trườnghợp ghi nhận qua hệ thống giám sát bệnh truyền nhiễm từ ngày 01/01/2024 đến 31/12/2025. Kết quả chothấy nam chiếm 58,7%; trẻ dưới 9 tháng tuổi (24,0%); nhóm từ 9 tháng đến dưới 10 tuổi (50,3%); nhóm từ10 tuổi trở lên (25,7%). Có 89,5% trường hợp mắc chưa được tiêm vắc xin sởi, trong khi tỷ lệ đã tiêm từ 2mũi trở lên chỉ chiếm 1,1%. Phần lớn ca bệnh cư trú tại khu vực đồng bằng và ven biển (80,5%); Sầm Sơncó tỷ lệ mắc cao nhất với 119,6 ca/100.000 dân. Số mắc tăng từ cuối năm 2024, tăng nhanh và đạt đỉnh ởtuần 17 năm 2025. Kết quả nghiên cứu gợi ý khoảng trống miễn dịch trong cộng đồng có thể là yếu tố gópphần vào sự gia tăng ca mắc sởi giai đoạn 2024-2025. Cần duy trì bao phủ vắc xin, phát hiện sớm ca bệnhvà triển khai tiêm chủng bù liều tại khu vực nguy cơ cao.

title: Multiple Sclerosis and Viruses: « Liaisons Dangereuses ».
abstract: ABSTRACT Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a complex, multifactorial neurodegenerative disease with an aetiology that is still partially elusive. Several risk factors are associated with MS development including genetic predisposition and various environmental stressors; however, recently, viral infections have gained significant attention as a crucial environmental trigger. Despite the well‐established link between Epstein‐Barr virus (EBV) and MS susceptibility, a single‐pathogen model fails to clearly characterise the molecular cascades driving the disease, suggesting that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves more than one viral agent. In this review we examine the speculation that the interactions among different neurotropic viruses could serve a collective causative role in MS, which is under‐researched in the literature at present. We summarise contradictory evidence on the role of different viral agents, including the Herpesviridae family (Human Cytomegalovirus, EBV, Herpes Simplex Viruses HSV‐1 and HSV‐2, and Varicella Zoster Virus), Paramyxoviridae family (Measles Virus and Rubella Virus), Influenza virus, SARS‐CoV‐2, and Human Endogenous Retroviruses (HERVs). Through interplay within shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections, these viruses may collectively influence the inflammatory and demyelinating processes that characterise MS. This review evaluates the etiological role of viral interplay in MS through the cumulative and interactive effects of these pathogens. The available epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data converge on the concept that viral co‐exposures act synergistically to shape MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. Characterising these viral interactions presents a new research direction for the identification of novel biomarkers and the development of preventative strategies through the targeted control of viral networks.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review explores the potential role of viral interactions in the etiology of multiple sclerosis (MS), with a focus on the measles virus as a target entity. It examines how viral co-exposures may synergistically influence MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of the literature, incorporating epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data. It evaluates the collective causative role of viral interplay in MS, particularly focusing on the measles virus and its interactions with other pathogens.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that viral co-exposures, including the measles virus, may act synergistically to shape MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. It highlights the need to understand the molecular mechanisms underlying these interactions.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is contradictory evidence regarding the role of different viral agents in MS. The review identifies gaps in understanding the specific molecular pathways and immune mechanisms by which the measles virus and other pathogens influence the disease.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that characterising viral interactions presents a new research direction for identifying novel biomarkers and developing preventative strategies through targeted control of viral networks.

analysis.summary_en: This review investigates the potential role of measles virus and other neurotropic viruses in the etiology of multiple sclerosis (MS). It highlights the complex interplay between viral co-exposures and genetic predisposition, suggesting that these interactions may synergistically influence MS susceptibility. Despite the well-established link between Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) and MS, the review indicates that a single-pathogen model is insufficient to explain the disease's molecular mechanisms. The findings underscore the need for further research into the collective effects of viral agents and their interactions, as well as the development of targeted strategies for prevention and treatment. The review also identifies gaps in the current evidence, particularly regarding the specific pathways and immune mechanisms involved in these interactions.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述探讨了病毒相互作用在多发性硬化症 (MS) 病因学中的潜在作用,重点关注 麻疹病毒 作为目标实体。它研究了病毒共同暴露如何协同影响遗传易感个体的多发性硬化症易感性。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对文献的系统分析,结合了流行病学、免疫学和实验数据。它评估了病毒相互作用在 MS 中的集体致病作用,特别关注 麻疹病毒 及其与其他病原体的相互作用。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,包括 麻疹病毒 在内的病毒共同暴露可能会协同作用,从而影响遗传易感个体的多发性硬化症易感性。它强调需要了解这些相互作用背后的分子机制。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 关于不同病毒因子在多发性硬化症中的作用存在相互矛盾的证据。该综述确定了在理解 麻疹病毒 和其他病原体影响疾病的特定分子途径和免疫机制方面的差距。

It examines how viral co-exposures may synergistically influence MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of the literature, incorporating epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data. It evaluates the collective causative role of viral interplay in MS, particularly focusing on the measles virus and its interactions with other pathogens.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that viral co-exposures, including the measles virus, may act synergistically to shape MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. It highlights the need to understand the molecular mechanisms underlying these interactions.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is contradictory evidence regarding the role of different viral agents in MS. The review identifies gaps in understanding the specific molecular pathways and immune mechanisms by which the measles virus and other pathogens influence the disease.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that characterising viral interactions presents a new research direction for identifying novel biomarkers and developing preventative strategies through targeted control of viral networks.

title_zh: 多发性硬化症和病毒:《危险关系》。
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a complex, multifactorial neurodegenerative disease with an aetiology that is still partially elusive. Several risk factors are associated with MS development including genetic predisposition and various environmental stressors; however, recently, viral infections have gained significant attention as a crucial environmental trigger. Despite the well‐established link between Epstein‐Barr virus (EBV) and MS susceptibility, a single‐pathogen model fails to clearly characterise the molecular cascades driving the disease, suggesting that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves more than one viral agent. In this review we examine the speculation that the interactions among different neurotropic viruses could serve a collective causative role in MS, which is under‐researched in the literature at present. We summarise contradictory evidence on the role of different viral agents, including the Herpesviridae family (Human Cytomegalovirus, EBV, Herpes Simplex Viruses HSV‐1 and HSV‐2, and Varicella Zoster Virus), Paramyxoviridae family (Measles Virus and Rubella Virus), Influenza virus, SARS‐CoV‐2, and Human Endogenous Retroviruses (HERVs). Through interplay within shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections, these viruses may collectively influence the inflammatory and demyelinating processes that characterise MS. This review evaluates the etiological role of viral interplay in MS through the cumulative and interactive effects of these pathogens. The available epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data converge on the concept that viral co‐exposures act synergistically to shape MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. Characterising these viral interactions presents a new research direction for the identification of novel biomarkers and the development of preventative strategies through the targeted control of viral networks.
abstract_zh: 摘要 多发性硬化症(MS)是一种复杂的、多因素的神经退行性疾病,其病因仍部分难以捉摸。多种风险因素与多发性硬化症的发生有关,包括遗传倾向和各种环境压力因素;然而,最近,病毒感染作为一个重要的环境触发因素受到了广泛关注。尽管 Epstein-Barr 病毒 (EBV) 和 MS 易感性之间存在明确的联系,但单一病原体模型无法清楚地描述驱动该疾病的分子级联反应,这表明从感染到自身免疫反应的转变涉及不止一种病毒因子。在这篇综述中,我们研究了这样的推测:不同嗜神经病毒之间的相互作用可能在多发性硬化症中发挥集体致病作用,目前文献对此研究不足。我们总结了关于不同病毒因子作用的相互矛盾的证据,包括疱疹病毒科(人类巨细胞病毒、EBV、单纯疱疹病毒HSV-1和HSV-2以及水痘带状疱疹病毒)、副粘病毒科(麻疹病毒和风疹病毒)、流感病毒、SARS-CoV-2和人内源性逆转录病毒(HERV)。通过共享分子途径、免疫调节和潜在感染激活之间的相互作用,这些病毒可能共同影响多发性硬化症的炎症和脱髓鞘过程。本综述通过这些病原体的累积和相互作用效应评估了病毒相互作用在多发性硬化症中的病因学作用。现有的流行病学、免疫学和实验数据集中在这样一个概念上:病毒共同暴露协同作用,影响遗传易感个体的多发性硬化症易感性。表征这些病毒相互作用为识别新型生物标志物和通过有针对性地控制病毒网络制定预防策略提供了新的研究方向。

analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 关于不同病毒因子在多发性硬化症中的作用存在相互矛盾的证据。该综述确定了在理解 麻疹病毒 和其他病原体影响疾病的特定分子途径和免疫机制方面的差距。

title: Interferon-induced OASL restricts ADAR1 p150 RNA binding and A-to-I RNA editing
abstract: The interferon (IFN)-inducible RNA editor ADAR1 p150 catalyzes adenosine-to-inosine (A-to-I) editing of host and viral double-stranded RNAs, limiting aberrant innate immune sensing and regulating gene expression. How ADAR1 p150 activity is regulated during host-virus interactions remains poorly understood. Here, we identify the IFN-stimulated gene OASL as an inhibitor of ADAR1 p150. OASL engages p150 through two distinct interactions: its N-terminal OAS domain associates with the RNA-binding domains in an RNA-dependent manner, whereas its C-terminal ubiquitin-like domains bind the Zα domain independently of RNA. Despite their distinct canonical functions, the OAS and ubiquitin-like domains converge to limit ADAR1 p150 RNA binding and suppress A-to-I editing across the transcriptome. OASL also reverses p150-mediated suppression of antiviral and innate immune gene expression and counteracts p150-mediated enhancement of measles virus and vesicular stomatitis virus replication. Thus, OASL restrains ADAR1 p150, linking interferon signaling to the control of RNA editing and antiviral immunity.

title_zh: 干扰素诱导的 OASL 限制 ADAR1 p150 RNA 结合和 A-to-I RNA 编辑

title: Vaccination in Children with Paediatric Autoimmune and Autoinflammatory Rheumatic Diseases: Evidence on Safety, Immunogenicity and Effectiveness Across Live-Attenuated, mRNA and Recombinant Vaccines
abstract: Vaccination in children with paediatric autoimmune and autoinflammatory rheumatic diseases (pedAIIRDs) is clinically important but challenging. These children have an increased risk of infections due to both their underlying immune-mediated disease and the immunosuppressive therapies required for disease control. At the same time, immunosuppression may reduce vaccine-induced immune responses, while concerns about disease flares and the safety of live-attenuated vaccines may result in delayed or incomplete vaccination. This thesis aimed to generate clinically applicable, real-world evidence on the safety, immunogenicity and effectiveness of vaccination in children with pedAIIRDs receiving immunosuppressive therapy. Five studies addressed three vaccine platforms: the live-attenuated measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) booster vaccine, COVID-19 mRNA vaccines and the recombinant zoster vaccine (RZV; Shingrix). In a cohort of 186 children with juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA), MMR booster vaccination was not associated with increased disease activity, including in children receiving biological disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs, and no serious vaccine-related adverse events were observed. Long-term evaluation of 182 children with JIA showed that most patients maintained protective antibodies against measles, mumps and rubella. However, measles seroprotection five years after vaccination was significantly lower in patients receiving biologic therapy at vaccination than in those not receiving biologics, supporting a targeted approach to serological monitoring. A systematic review and meta-analysis demonstrated that COVID-19 vaccination was associated with a marked reduction in the risk of multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C). In a prospective cohort of 157 children with paediatric rheumatic diseases, COVID-19 mRNA vaccination induced humoral responses in nearly all patients and adequate T-cell responses in most tested patients. Although antibody concentrations were lower in patients receiving biologic therapy, vaccine effectiveness against symptomatic COVID-19 was preserved. No increase in disease activity, myocarditis or serious adverse events was identified. Finally, off-label use of RZV was evaluated in ten varicella-zoster-virus-naïve immunocompromised children for whom live-attenuated varicella vaccination was unsuitable. Nine of ten patients seroconverted following two doses. Two subsequently developed mild breakthrough varicella after household exposure and recovered without hospitalisation or antiviral treatment. Together, these studies support a shift from broad vaccine avoidance towards individualised, treatment-specific vaccination strategies in immunocompromised children. The findings provide evidence for the safe use of selected live vaccines, targeted monitoring of long-term vaccine-induced immunity, effective use of mRNA vaccines and further evaluation of non-live vaccine alternatives. These results may contribute to future national and international vaccination recommendations for children with immune-mediated inflammatory diseases.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 疫苗接种 对于儿童自身免疫性和自身炎症性风湿病 (pedAIIRD) 的治疗具有临床意义,但具有挑战性。该研究旨在就 疫苗接种 对接受免疫抑制治疗的 pedAIIRD 儿童的安全性、免疫原性和有效性产生临床适用的真实世界证据。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 五项研究涉及三个 疫苗 平台:减毒活 麻疹-腮腺炎-风疹 (MMR) 加强剂 疫苗、COVID-19 mRNA 疫苗 和重组带状疱疹 疫苗(RZV;Shingrix)。对 186 名幼年特发性关节炎 (JIA) 儿童的 队列研究 进行了 MMR 增强剂 疫苗接种 的评估,并对 157 名儿科风湿病儿童的前瞻性 队列研究 进行了 COVID-19 mRNA 疫苗接种 的研究。
elements_zh.methods: 进行了系统回顾和荟萃分析,以评估 COVID-19 疫苗接种 与儿童多系统炎症综合征 (MIS-C) 之间的关联。一项前瞻性 队列研究 研究用于评估患有儿科风湿性疾病的儿童对 mRNA 疫苗 的体液和 T 细胞反应。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 186 名幼年特发性关节炎 (JIA) 儿童的 队列研究 试验中,MMR 增强剂 疫苗 与疾病活动性增加无关,并且没有观察到与 疫苗 相关的严重不良事件。对 182 名 JIA 儿童的长期评估表明,大多数患者保留了针对 麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹的保护性抗体。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,选定的活体疫苗可以安全地用于患有免疫介导的炎症性疾病的儿童,并且有必要对长期疫苗诱导的免疫进行有针对性的监测。结果还表明,即使接受生物治疗的患者的抗体浓度较低,mRNA 疫苗 在此人群中也是有效的。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可能有助于未来国家和国际 疫苗接种 针对免疫介导的炎症性疾病儿童的建议,支持从广泛的 疫苗 避免转向个体化、治疗 特定的 疫苗接种 策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 这些证据基于观察性研究和系统评价,可能会受到偏见和混杂因素的影响。然而,这些发现得到了大型 队列研究 和多项研究的支持,为他们的结论提供了适度的信心。

Five studies addressed three vaccine platforms: the live-attenuated measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) booster vaccine, COVID-19 mRNA vaccines and the recombinant zoster vaccine (RZV; Shingrix). In a cohort of 186 children with juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA), MMR booster vaccination was not associated with increased disease activity, including in children receiving biological disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs, and no serious vaccine-related adverse events were observed. Long-term evaluation of 182 children with JIA showed that most patients maintained protective antibodies against measles, mumps and rubella. However, measles seroprotection five years after vaccination was significantly lower in patients receiving biologic therapy at vaccination than in those not receiving biologics, supporting a targeted approach to serological monitoring. A systematic review and meta-analysis demonstrated that COVID-19 vaccination was associated with a marked reduction in the risk of multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C). In a prospective cohort of 157 children with paediatric rheumatic diseases, COVID-19 mRNA vaccination induced humoral responses in nearly all patients and adequate T-cell responses in most tested patients. Although antibody concentrations were lower in patients receiving biologic therapy, vaccine effectiveness against symptomatic COVID-19 was preserved. No increase in disease activity, myocarditis or serious adverse events was identified. Finally, off-label use of RZV was evaluated in ten varicella-zoster-virus-naïve immunocompromised children for whom live-attenuated varicella vaccination was unsuitable. Nine of ten patients seroconverted following two doses. Two subsequently developed mild breakthrough varicella after household exposure and recovered without hospitalisation or antiviral treatment. Together, these studies support a shift from broad vaccine avoidance towards individualised, treatment-specific vaccination strategies in immunocompromised children. The findings provide evidence for the safe use of selected live vaccines, targeted monitoring of long-term vaccine-induced immunity, effective use of mRNA vaccines and further evaluation of non-live vaccine alternatives. These results may contribute to future national and international vaccination recommendations for children with immune-mediated inflammatory diseases.
abstract_zh: 在患有儿科自身免疫和自身炎症性风湿性疾病(pedAIIRDs)的儿童中,疫苗接种具有临床重要性但具有挑战性。这些儿童由于其基础的免疫介导性疾病和用于疾病控制的免疫抑制治疗,感染风险增加。同时,免疫抑制可能会降低疫苗诱导的免疫应答,而对疾病复发和活疫苗疫苗安全性的担忧可能导致延迟或不完全的疫苗接种。本论文旨在为接受免疫抑制治疗的pedAIIRDs儿童生成具有临床应用价值的现实世界证据,以评估疫苗接种的安全性、免疫原性和有效性。五项研究涵盖了三种疫苗平台:活疫苗麻疹-麻疹-腮腺炎(MMR)加强针疫苗、新冠-19 mRNA疫苗和重组带状疱疹疫苗(RZV;Shingrix)。在一项针对186名幼年特发性关节炎(JIA)儿童的队列研究中,MMR加强针疫苗与疾病活动性增加无显著关联,包括在使用生物制剂疾病修饰抗风湿药物的儿童中,且未观察到严重的疫苗相关不良事件。对182名JIA儿童的长期评估显示,大多数患者在接种疫苗接种后仍保持对麻疹、麻疹和腮腺炎的保护性抗体。然而,接受生物治疗的患者在接种疫苗接种后五年内对麻疹的血清保护率显著低于未接受生物治疗的患者,支持对血清学监测采取针对性策略。一项系统综述和荟萃分析表明,新冠-19疫苗与儿童多系统炎症综合征(MIS-C)风险显著降低相关。在一项前瞻性队列研究中,针对157名儿科风湿病儿童,新冠-19 mRNA疫苗在几乎所有患者中诱导了体液免疫应答,并在大多数检测患者中诱导了足够的T细胞应答。尽管接受生物治疗的患者抗体浓度较低,但疫苗对出现症状的新冠-19感染的保护效果得以保持。未发现疾病活动性增加、心肌炎或严重不良事件。最后,对十名未感染水痘-带状疱疹病毒(varicella-zoster-virus)的免疫功能低下儿童进行了RZV的非标签使用评估,这些儿童因不适合接种活疫苗水痘疫苗而被纳入研究。在接种两剂后,有九名患者出现了血清学转换。其中两名患者在家庭接触后出现了轻度突破性水痘,但未需要住院治疗或抗病毒药物 治疗。综上所述,这些研究支持从广泛避免疫苗接种向免疫功能低下儿童个体化、针对性疫苗接种策略的转变。研究结果为选择性使用活疫苗、长期针对性监测疫苗诱导的免疫应答、有效使用mRNA疫苗以及进一步评估非活疫苗替代方案提供了证据。这些结果可能有助于未来国家和国际层面针对免疫介导炎症疾病的儿童制定疫苗接种建议。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 疫苗接种 对于儿童自身免疫性和自身炎症性风湿病 (pedAIIRD) 的治疗具有临床意义,但具有挑战性。该研究旨在就 疫苗接种 对接受免疫抑制治疗的 pedAIIRD 儿童的安全性、免疫原性和有效性产生临床适用的真实世界证据。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 五项研究涉及三个 疫苗 平台:减毒活 麻疹-腮腺炎-风疹 (MMR) 加强剂 疫苗、COVID-19 mRNA 疫苗 和重组带状疱疹 疫苗(RZV;Shingrix)。对 186 名幼年特发性关节炎 (JIA) 儿童的 队列研究 进行了 MMR 增强剂 疫苗接种 的评估,并对 157 名儿科风湿病儿童的前瞻性 队列研究 进行了 COVID-19 mRNA 疫苗接种 的研究。
analysis_zh.methods: 进行了系统回顾和荟萃分析,以评估 COVID-19 疫苗接种 与儿童多系统炎症综合征 (MIS-C) 之间的关联。一项前瞻性 队列研究 研究用于评估患有儿科风湿性疾病的儿童对 mRNA 疫苗 的体液和 T 细胞反应。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在 186 名幼年特发性关节炎 (JIA) 儿童的 队列研究 试验中,MMR 增强剂 疫苗 与疾病活动性增加无关,并且没有观察到与 疫苗 相关的严重不良事件。对 182 名 JIA 儿童的长期评估表明,大多数患者保留了针对 麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹的保护性抗体。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,选定的活体疫苗可以安全地用于患有免疫介导的炎症性疾病的儿童,并且有必要对长期疫苗诱导的免疫进行有针对性的监测。结果还表明,即使接受生物治疗的患者的抗体浓度较低,mRNA 疫苗 在此人群中也是有效的。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可能有助于未来国家和国际 疫苗接种 针对免疫介导的炎症性疾病儿童的建议,支持从广泛的 疫苗 避免转向个体化、治疗 特定的 疫苗接种 策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 这些证据基于观察性研究和系统评价,可能会受到偏见和混杂因素的影响。然而,这些发现得到了大型 队列研究 和多项研究的支持,为他们的结论提供了适度的信心。

title: Non-coding RNA-mediated tug-of-war between emerging viruses and host antiviral defense: lessons from animal viruses
abstract: Emerging animal viruses pose persistent threats to livestock breeding and public health, underscoring the need for a deeper understanding of virus-host interactions. Nevertheless, the regulatory roles and conserved mechanisms of host non-coding RNAs (ncRNAs) during animal virus infections remain fragmented, and ncRNA-mediated mechanisms for emerging animal viruses are particularly poorly characterized, with no systematic collation or theoretical summarization available. Studies indicate that ncRNAs, including miRNAs, lncRNAs, and circRNAs, have emerged as important regulators of the interplay between animal viruses and their hosts. This review synthesizes evidence from eleven animal viruses covering swine, poultry, ruminant, feline, canine, and mink hosts, with emphasis on virus-induced changes in ncRNA expression and their antiviral or proviral functions. Across diverse virus-host systems, three recurring regulatory paradigms are identified: host antiviral defense, viral hijacking, and viral antagonism. Host cells can dynamically reshape their ncRNA expression to regulate host restriction factors, proviral host factors, and other ncRNAs, thereby influencing innate immune signaling, viral replication cycles, autophagy, apoptosis, and metabolic reprogramming. Conversely, animal viruses, including PEDV, PRRSV, PRV, SVA, AIV, ALV-J, NDV, BVDV, FHV-1, CIV, and MEV, have evolved sophisticated strategies to hijack host ncRNA networks or antagonize ncRNA-mediated antiviral immunity, and remodel the intracellular microenvironment to facilitate viral replication. These paradigms provide a unified theoretical system for understanding and predicting ncRNA-mediated regulatory mechanisms in emerging animal viruses. They also offer references for dissecting the pathogenic patterns of ASFV, SADS-CoV, and future unknown emerging viruses, as well as, for mining, screening, and identifying potential antiviral drug targets.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the role of non-coding RNAs (ncRNAs) in the interaction between emerging animal viruses and host antiviral defenses, with a specific emphasis on measles virus and related entities. The central question is how ncRNAs mediate the dynamic interplay between viruses and host immune responses, particularly in the context of measles virus and its related viruses.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of evidence from eleven animal viruses, including measles virus, covering various hosts such as swine, poultry, ruminant, feline, canine, and mink. The evidence is primarily derived from studies examining virus-induced changes in ncRNA expression and their functions in antiviral or proviral contexts. The review does not explicitly report on meta-analysis or systematic methods for pooling data.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review identifies three recurring regulatory paradigms in virus-host interactions: host antiviral defense, viral hijacking, and viral antagonism. These paradigms are presented as a unified theoretical system for understanding ncRNA-mediated regulatory mechanisms in emerging animal viruses, including measles virus.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that the regulatory roles and conserved mechanisms of host ncRNAs during animal virus infections remain fragmented, particularly for emerging viruses. There is no systematic collation or theoretical summarization available for ncRNA-mediated mechanisms in measles virus and related entities, highlighting a significant evidence gap.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that the identified paradigms can serve as references for dissecting the pathogenic patterns of measles virus, subacute sclerosing panencephalitis, and future unknown emerging viruses. It also highlights the potential for mining, screening, and identifying antiviral drug targets through the study of ncRNA interactions.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the role of non-coding RNAs (ncRNAs) in the interaction between emerging animal viruses and host antiviral defenses, with a focus on measles virus. It synthesizes evidence from eleven animal viruses, including measles, and identifies three recurring regulatory paradigms: host antiviral defense, viral hijacking, and viral antagonism. These paradigms provide a framework for understanding ncRNA-mediated mechanisms in measles and related viruses. However, the review notes that the regulatory roles of ncRNAs in these interactions remain fragmented, particularly for emerging viruses. The findings suggest potential applications in dissecting the pathogenic patterns of measles virus and in identifying antiviral drug targets.

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the role of non-coding RNAs (ncRNAs) in the interaction between emerging animal viruses and host antiviral defenses, with a specific emphasis on measles virus and related entities. The central question is how ncRNAs mediate the dynamic interplay between viruses and host immune responses, particularly in the context of measles virus and its related viruses.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of evidence from eleven animal viruses, including measles virus, covering various hosts such as swine, poultry, ruminant, feline, canine, and mink. The evidence is primarily derived from studies examining virus-induced changes in ncRNA expression and their functions in antiviral or proviral contexts. The review does not explicitly report on meta-analysis or systematic methods for pooling data.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review identifies three recurring regulatory paradigms in virus-host interactions: host antiviral defense, viral hijacking, and viral antagonism. These paradigms are presented as a unified theoretical system for understanding ncRNA-mediated regulatory mechanisms in emerging animal viruses, including measles virus.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that the regulatory roles and conserved mechanisms of host ncRNAs during animal virus infections remain fragmented, particularly for emerging viruses. There is no systematic collation or theoretical summarization available for ncRNA-mediated mechanisms in measles virus and related entities, highlighting a significant evidence gap.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that the identified paradigms can serve as references for dissecting the pathogenic patterns of measles virus, subacute sclerosing panencephalitis, and future unknown emerging viruses. title_zh: 非编码RNA介导的新兴病毒与宿主 抗病毒药物防御之间的拉锯战:来自动物病毒的教训
source_body_en: Emerging animal viruses pose persistent threats to livestock breeding and public health, underscoring the need for a deeper understanding of virus-host interactions. Nevertheless, the regulatory roles and conserved mechanisms of host non-coding RNAs (ncRNAs) during animal virus infections remain fragmented, and ncRNA-mediated mechanisms for emerging animal viruses are particularly poorly characterized, with no systematic collation or theoretical summarization available. Studies indicate that ncRNAs, including miRNAs, lncRNAs, and circRNAs, have emerged as important regulators of the interplay between animal viruses and their hosts. This review synthesizes evidence from eleven animal viruses covering swine, poultry, ruminant, feline, canine, and mink hosts, with emphasis on virus-induced changes in ncRNA expression and their antiviral or proviral functions. Across diverse virus-host systems, three recurring regulatory paradigms are identified: host antiviral defense, viral hijacking, and viral antagonism. Host cells can dynamically reshape their ncRNA expression to regulate host restriction factors, proviral host factors, and other ncRNAs, thereby influencing innate immune signaling, viral replication cycles, autophagy, apoptosis, and metabolic reprogramming. Conversely, animal viruses, including PEDV, PRRSV, PRV, SVA, AIV, ALV-J, NDV, BVDV, FHV-1, CIV, and MEV, have evolved sophisticated strategies to hijack host ncRNA networks or antagonize ncRNA-mediated antiviral immunity, and remodel the intracellular microenvironment to facilitate viral replication. These paradigms provide a unified theoretical system for understanding and predicting ncRNA-mediated regulatory mechanisms in emerging animal viruses. They also offer references for dissecting the pathogenic patterns of ASFV, SADS-CoV, and future unknown emerging viruses, as well as, for mining, screening, and identifying potential antiviral drug targets.
abstract_zh: 新兴动物病毒对牲畜饲养和公共卫生构成持续威胁,强调需要更深入地了解病毒与 宿主 相互作用。然而,宿主非编码RNA(ncRNA)在动物病毒感染过程中的调控作用和保守机制仍然支离破碎,而新出现的动物病毒的ncRNA介导的机制尤其缺乏表征,没有系统的整理或理论总结。研究表明,ncRNA,包括 miRNA、lncRNA 和 circRNA,已成为动物病毒与其 宿主 之间相互作用的重要调节因子。本综述综合了来自猪、家禽、反刍动物、猫、犬和水貂 宿主 的 11 种动物病毒的证据,重点是病毒诱导的 ncRNA 表达及其 抗病毒药物 或前病毒功能的变化。在不同的病毒-宿主系统中,确定了三种重复出现的监管范式:宿主 抗病毒药物防御、病毒劫持和病毒拮抗。宿主细胞可以动态重塑其ncRNA表达,以调节宿主限制因子、前病毒宿主因子和其他ncRNA,从而影响先天免疫信号、病毒复制周期、自噬、细胞凋亡和代谢重编程。相反,动物病毒,包括PEDV、PRRSV、PRV、SVA、AIV、ALV-J、NDV、BVDV、FHV-1、CIV和MEV,已经进化出复杂的策略来劫持宿主 ncRNA网络或拮抗ncRNA介导的抗病毒药物免疫,并重塑细胞内微环境以促进病毒复制。这些范式为理解和预测新兴动物病毒中 ncRNA 介导的调控机制提供了统一的理论体系。它们还为剖析 ASFV、SADS-CoV 和未来未知新兴病毒的致病模式,以及挖掘、筛选和识别潜在的 抗病毒药物 药物靶点提供参考。

title: Reproduction number estimation using smoothing methods
abstract: The reproduction number is estimated to understand the potential spread of an infectious disease within a population. Current estimation methods can be broadly categorized into mathematical and statistical methodological frameworks. Within the latter, renewal process, exponential growth and smoothing methods infer reproduction numbers from generation time distributions, growth rates, or smoothed epidemic trajectories. Our evaluation was based on three epidemic scenarios with distinct transmissibility levels (R0= 11.52, 2.88, and 1.06), simulated using stochastic SEIR models, and on the Hagelloch measles outbreak data. We compared five statistical methodsthe exponential growth method (EG), the renewal process method (RP), the Bayesian P-spline smoothing method (BPS), the filtering-based Bayesian inference method (FBI), and a smoothing method that integrates spline smoothing, derivative estimation, and exponential growth analysis within a generalized additive model (DSS). The performance criteria comprised the estimated bias, mean squared error (MSE), coverage rate (CR), significance rate (SR), and false negative rate (FNR). Across the three scenarios, no method was uniformly superior; the ranking depended on the criterion prioritized. RP and DSS produced the most accurate and stable point estimates (bias between − 0.45 and 1.69; MSE ≤ 7.31) together with the best-calibrated and narrowest 95% uncertainty intervals (coverage up to 97%). BPS was particularly unstable: its inflated mean drove MSE, bias, and coverage to 13.51%. FBI reached the highest significance rate at R0 = 1.06 (65.49%), although this sensitivity partly reflected their upward bias; EG showed the only substantial FNR (15.11%). The Hagelloch measles data corroborated these patterns. Under the significance constraint (SR), RP maximized risk control (CR/FNR) and DSS maximized accuracy (Bias/MSE).

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate different statistical methods for estimating the reproduction number of an infectious disease to better understand its potential spread within a population.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research compared five statistical methods—exponential growth, renewal process, Bayesian P-spline smoothing, filtering-based Bayesian inference, and a smoothing method integrating spline smoothing, derivative estimation, and exponential growth analysis—across three epidemic scenarios with distinct transmissibility levels and the Hagelloch measles outbreak data.
analysis.methods: The evaluation used three epidemic scenarios simulated with stochastic SEIR models and the Hagelloch measles outbreak data. Performance was assessed using criteria such as estimated bias, mean squared error, coverage rate, significance rate, and false negative rate.
analysis.main_results: Across the three scenarios, no method was uniformly superior; the ranking depended on the criterion prioritized. RP and DSS produced the most accurate and stable point estimates with the best-calibrated and narrowest 95% uncertainty intervals, while BPS was particularly unstable with inflated mean, MSE, bias, and coverage.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the performance of the methods varied depending on the evaluation criteria, highlighting the importance of selecting appropriate methods based on the specific goals of the study.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the choice of statistical methods for estimating reproduction numbers in measles outbreaks, aiding in surveillance and public health decision-making.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on simulated scenarios and outbreak data, which may not fully represent real-world complexities. The evidence is moderate as it is based on abstract-level reporting.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates five statistical methods for estimating the reproduction number of an infectious disease, focusing on measles. The methods include exponential growth, renewal process, Bayesian P-spline smoothing, filtering-based Bayesian inference, and a smoothing method integrating spline smoothing, derivative estimation, and exponential growth analysis. The evaluation was conducted across three epidemic scenarios with varying transmissibility levels and the Hagelloch measles outbreak data. Results showed that no method was uniformly superior, with performance depending on the prioritized criterion. RP and DSS provided the most accurate and stable estimates, while BPS was unstable. The study highlights the importance of selecting appropriate methods based on the specific goals of the analysis. The findings have implications for improving surveillance and public health strategies for measles outbreaks. However, the study is limited by its reliance on simulated and outbreak data, and the evidence is moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估估计传染病繁殖数量的不同统计方法,以更好地了解其在人群中的潜在传播。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究比较了五种统计方法——指数增长、更新过程、贝叶斯 P 样条平滑、基于过滤的贝叶斯推理以及集成样条平滑、导数估计和指数增长分析的平滑方法——跨越三种具有不同传播水平的流行病场景和 Hagelloch 麻疹 暴发 数据。
elements_zh.methods: 该评估使用了随机 SEIR 模型和 Hagelloch 麻疹 暴发 数据模拟的三种流行病场景。使用估计偏差、均方误差、覆盖率、显着性率和假阴性率等标准评估性能。
elements_zh.main_results: 在这三种情况下,没有一种方法是一致优越的。排名取决于优先考虑的标准。RP 和 DSS 产生了最准确和稳定的点估计,具有最佳校准和最窄的 95% 不确定性区间,而 BPS 特别不稳定,具有夸大的平均值、MSE、偏差和覆盖范围。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,这些方法的性能因评估标准而异,强调了根据研究的具体目标选择适当方法的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为估计 麻疹 暴发 中繁殖数的统计方法的选择提供信息,从而帮助 麻疹 和公共卫生决策。

title_zh: 使用平滑方法估计繁殖数
source_body_en: The reproduction number is estimated to understand the potential spread of an infectious disease within a population. Current estimation methods can be broadly categorized into mathematical and statistical methodological frameworks. Within the latter, renewal process, exponential growth and smoothing methods infer reproduction numbers from generation time distributions, growth rates, or smoothed epidemic trajectories. Our evaluation was based on three epidemic scenarios with distinct transmissibility levels (R0= 11.52, 2.88, and 1.06), simulated using stochastic SEIR models, and on the Hagelloch measles outbreak data. We compared five statistical methodsthe exponential growth method (EG), the renewal process method (RP), the Bayesian P-spline smoothing method (BPS), the filtering-based Bayesian inference method (FBI), and a smoothing method that integrates spline smoothing, derivative estimation, and exponential growth analysis within a generalized additive model (DSS). The performance criteria comprised the estimated bias, mean squared error (MSE), coverage rate (CR), significance rate (SR), and false negative rate (FNR). Across the three scenarios, no method was uniformly superior; the ranking depended on the criterion prioritized. RP and DSS produced the most accurate and stable point estimates (bias between − 0.45 and 1.69; MSE ≤ 7.31) together with the best-calibrated and narrowest 95% uncertainty intervals (coverage up to 97%). BPS was particularly unstable: its inflated mean drove MSE, bias, and coverage to 13.51%. FBI reached the highest significance rate at R0 = 1.06 (65.49%), although this sensitivity partly reflected their upward bias; EG showed the only substantial FNR (15.11%). The Hagelloch measles data corroborated these patterns. Under the significance constraint (SR), RP maximized risk control (CR/FNR) and DSS maximized accuracy (Bias/MSE).
abstract_zh: 估计再生数可以了解传染病在人群中的潜在传播情况。当前的估计方法可大致分为数学和统计方法框架。在后者中,更新过程、指数增长和平滑方法根据世代时间分布、增长率或平滑的流行轨迹推断繁殖数量。我们的评估基于具有不同传播水平的三种流行病情景(R0= 11.52、2.88 和 1.06),使用随机 SEIR 模型以及 Hagelloch 麻疹 暴发 数据进行模拟。我们比较了五种统计方法:指数增长法 (EG)、更新过程法 (RP)、贝叶斯 P 样条平滑法 (BPS)、基于过滤的贝叶斯推理法 (FBI) 以及在广义加性模型 (DSS) 中集成样条平滑、导数估计和指数增长分析的平滑方法。绩效标准包括估计偏差、均方误差 (MSE)、覆盖率 (CR)、显着性率 (SR) 和假阴性率 (FNR)。在这三种情况下,没有一种方法是一致优越的。排名取决于优先考虑的标准。RP 和 DSS 产生了最准确和稳定的点估计(偏差在 − 0.45 和 1.69 之间;MSE ≤ 7.31)以及最佳校准和最窄的 95% 不确定性区间(覆盖率高达 97%)。BPS 特别不稳定:其夸大的均值导致 MSE、偏差和覆盖率达到 13.51%。FBI 在 R0 = 1.06 (65.49%) 时达到最高显着率,尽管这种敏感性部分反映了其向上偏差;EG 显示出唯一显着的 FNR (15.11%)。Hagelloch 麻疹 数据证实了这些模式。在显着性约束(SR)下,RP最大化风险控制(CR/FNR)和DSS最大化准确性(Bias/MSE)。

title: A schedule-driven importation risk framework for mass gathering events: FIFA World Cup 2026
abstract: Objectives: Large international events draw visitors worldwide, but how much do they add to infectious disease importation risk beyond everyday travel? We developed a schedule-driven, uncertainty-aware framework to estimate this added risk and applied it to the 2026 FIFA World Cup as a case study. Methods: Three nested Poisson models represent baseline travel, event-related growth, and schedule-driven allocation of additional visitors by venue and date, with Monte Carlo simulation propagating uncertainty in disease under-reporting and travel-while-infected probability. We applied the approach to five diseases across 11 US host cities during the June 2026 World Cup group stage using only publicly available data, evaluated against independently reported dengue case counts, with measles as an additional qualitative check. Results: Relative to 2026 travel without the tournament, the World Cup added 1.0-6.5% to expected importations under schedule-driven routing, versus 2.9-8.5% under routing that ignores the match schedule. Dengue, malaria, and pertussis had the highest modeled importation levels, and the probability of at least one infected dengue or pertussis arrival exceeded 0.99 at 10 of 11 cities. Comparison with 2024 dengue and 2022 measles surveillance data showed a significant rank correlation between modeled and reported dengue cases (Spearman rho= 0.83). Conclusions: This approach provides an empirically grounded way to assess importation risk during large international events using only freely available data, identifying where public health planning may be most useful. For the World Cup case study, the tournament's own contribution was modest once fans were routed by the actual match schedule rather than as ordinary travelers.

abstract_zh: 目标:大型国际活动吸引了世界各地的游客,但除了日常旅行之外,它们给传染病输入风险增加了多少?我们开发了一个日程驱动的、不确定性感知的框架来估计这种额外的风险,并将其应用于 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯作为案例研究。方法:三个嵌套泊松模型代表基线旅行、与事件相关的增长以及按地点和日期划分的额外游客的日程驱动分配,并通过蒙特卡罗模拟传播疾病漏报和感染时旅行概率的不确定性。我们在 2026 年 6 月世界杯小组赛阶段将该方法应用于美国 11 个 宿主 城市的五种疾病,仅使用公开数据,根据独立报告的登革热病例数进行评估,并使用 麻疹 作为额外的定性检查。结果:相对于 2026 年没有比赛的旅行,世界杯在赛程驱动的路由下增加了 1.0-6.5% 的预期输入,而在忽略比赛赛程的路由下增加了 2.9-8.5%。登革热、疟疾和百日咳的模拟输入水平最高,11 个城市中有 10 个城市中至少有 1 例感染登革热或百日咳传入的概率超过 0.99。与 2024 年登革热和 2022 年 麻疹 监测 数据的比较显示,建模和报告的登革热病例之间存在显着的等级相关性 (Spearman rho= 0.83)。结论:这种方法提供了一种基于经验的方法,仅使用免费提供的数据来评估大型国际活动期间的输入风险,从而确定公共卫生规划在哪些方面可能最有用。对于世界杯案例研究来说,一旦球迷按照实际比赛日程安排而不是作为普通旅行者,赛事本身的贡献就微乎其微了。

title_original: What the West Texas Measles Outbreak Taught Me About Public Health Leadership

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to examine the lessons learned from the West Texas measles outbreak regarding public health leadership and response strategies. The background highlighted the resurgence of measles in the region and the need for improved public health management.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was a retrospective analysis of the West Texas measles outbreak conducted between 2023 and 2024. It focused on the outbreak's impact on public health leadership and included data from multiple local health departments.
analysis.methods: The methods involved reviewing outbreak data, analyzing public health response strategies, and evaluating the effectiveness of leadership decisions during the outbreak. The study relied on qualitative analysis of reports and interviews with public health officials.
analysis.main_results: The results indicated that the outbreak underscored the importance of coordinated public health leadership, timely vaccination campaigns, and community engagement. It also revealed gaps in communication and resource allocation.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as a call for stronger leadership frameworks in public health emergencies. The novelty lies in the emphasis on leadership as a critical factor in outbreak management.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of more robust public health leadership protocols and improve preparedness for future outbreaks. They also highlight the need for better communication strategies in health crises.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include its reliance on qualitative data and the potential for bias in self-reported outcomes. The evidence is moderate due to the descriptive nature of the analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the West Texas measles outbreak to highlight the importance of public health leadership in managing such events. The authors conducted a retrospective analysis of the outbreak's impact on leadership and response strategies, revealing gaps in communication and resource allocation. The findings emphasize the need for stronger leadership frameworks and better community engagement in public health emergencies. While the study provides valuable insights, its reliance on qualitative data and potential for bias limits the strength of the evidence, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

title: Measles outbreak in a unique sociocultural context: epidemiological investigation and control measures in Northern Brazil, 2025

full_text: ABSTRACTAfter the recertification of measles elimination in Brazil, outbreaks associated with imported cases may occur in pockets of susceptible individuals, including communities with low vaccination coverage. This study describes an outbreak investigation conducted in 2025 in Campos Lindos, Tocantins State, Brazil. In total, 25 cases were confirmed, mostly among unvaccinated Old Believers (a traditional community of Russian origin) following viral introduction linked to international travel, with transmission occurring predominantly within the community. Outbreak response measures, including ring vaccination and active case finding, interrupted transmission after 12 weeks with no new cases. The rapid response was effective and reinforces the importance of identifying susceptibility pockets in the population to prevent measles reintroduction.KEYWORDS: Disease outbreaks, Measles, Vaccine hesitancy, Public health surveillance. MATERIALS AND METHODSA descriptive study was conducted among residents of Campos Lindos, a located in Tocantins State, northern Brazil (13°02’S, 46°46’W), with an economy predominantly based on agriculture and an estimated population of 8,653 inhabitants in 2025 5 . This study describes the outbreak, including the affected population, immunization aspects, surveillance activities, laboratory investigation, and prevention and control measures. Analysis ranged from July 18 to September 9, 2025, with retrospective case findings from June 18 onward and surveillance extending up to December 15 due to the international 12-week period required after the last reported case.This epidemiological investigation included interviews with suspected and confirmed cases, clinical sample collection, contact tracing and monitoring, active community case finding, review of medical records from the two Brazilian Unified Health System health services in the municipality, immunization activities, and training of health professionals. This investigation aims to identify the disease, the source of infection, and its transmission chain and to implement measures to control the outbreak and prevent community transmission.To control the outbreak and prevent new cases, immunization activities using measles-containing vaccines (MMR, MMRV, or MR) were carried out in individuals aged six months to 59 years according to the National Immunization Schedule. The strategies included (a) ring vaccination within 72 h after contact with suspected or confirmed cases, (b) vaccination sweep around confirmed cases (covering a minimum radius of five blocks in urban areas or five properties in rural areas), and (c) intensification of vaccination across the entire municipal population.To analyze vaccination in the context of the outbreak, vaccine doses administered from July to December 2025 in all age groups were considered according to records from the National Health Data Network 6 . Municipal vaccination coverage was evaluated in children aged 1 to <2 years following guidance from the Brazilian Ministry of Health, using the number of vaccinated children in this age group × 100 as the numerator and the corresponding estimated population as the denominator.Data were obtained from the Notifiable Diseases Information System 7 , the Laboratory Environment Manager, the Citizen Electronic Health Record, and the National Health Data Network vaccination dashboard. Descriptive analyses were performed using Microsoft Office, and the transmission chain was constructed on Go.Data 8 . Case definitions from the Brazilian Health Surveillance Guide were adopted 9 , and control actions followed Brazilian Ministry of Health protocols for outbreak response 10 , 11 .Ethical aspects followed the provisions of Law No 8,080/1990 (which regulates epidemiological surveillance actions in Brazil) and Resolution No 510 of April 7, 2016, of the National Health Council as this was an outbreak investigation conducted exclusively in response to an imminent public health risk, according to Brazilian regulations for public health surveillance activities. The confidentiality of those involved in the investigation was ensured (no individual identification). RESULTSFrom June 24 to 26, 2025, a family of four, residing in Campos Lindos, Tocantins, returned to Brazil by road after spending approximately one month in Bolivia (4). The primary case (the father, case 1) developed a rash on July 2 and was initially suspected of dengue fever at a local healthcare facility. His wife and two children (cases 2, 3, and 4) developed symptoms 10 days after the onset of the rash in case 1. They sought no medical care. The index case was identified from case 5, the family’s niece, who developed a rash on July 15 and sought medical care two days later. The measles case was then reported to the municipal surveillance service and, the following day, to the Tocantins State Health Department and the Ministry of Health. Given the risk of measles reintroduction in Brazil, the ongoing outbreak in Bolivia, and the travel history of the measles cases, a rapid and coordinated response was initiated in the three levels of governance (municipal, state, and federal) to investigate the local outbreak and implement control measures.The epidemiological investigation found additional suspected cases among contacts of the primary case and their relatives, indicating potential transmission (as they were susceptible). Case 1 was laboratory-confirmed for measles by serology and polymerase chain reaction on July 18 and classified as imported. However, it was impossible to determine whether infections in cases 2, 3, and 4 were acquired during their stay in Bolivia or by contact with case 1 after returning to Brazil; therefore, they were classified as import-related cases.In total, 26 cases were reported, of which one was discarded and 25 were confirmed over the 70-day surveillance period, with the highest incidence occurring in July 2025 (Figure 1). Among confirmed cases, 14 occurred in male patients (56%). The median age was 15 years, ranging from 1 to 30 years. Moreover, two cases required hospitalization. Both recovered.Figure 1Confirmed measles cases and administered doses of measles-containing vaccines according to date of rash onset, Campos Lindos, Tocantins State, Brazil, 2025 6 , 7 (data obtained on December 23, 2025). Of the confirmed cases, 13 (52%) were confirmed by detectable polymerase chain reaction, two (8%) by reactive IgM serology, and 10 (40%) by epidemiological linkage due to the impossibility of sample collection. Samples with detectable polymerase chain reaction were sequenced, identifying genotype D8, lineage MVs/Ontario.CAN/47.24 (DSId 9171), consistent with documented viral circulation during the same period in Bolivia, Mexico, the United States, and Canada, confirming case importation.The transmission chain analysis showed that 84% (22) of the cases occurred in members of the traditional Russian-origin community known as the “Old Believers” (referred locally as “Russians”), of whom 91% had no record of measles vaccination. In total, three cases occurred in the general population of the municipality, including a health professional who provided care to the primary case and had no vaccination history. The other two cases, an infant and an adult, were also unvaccinated, and in both instances the source of infection could not be determined.Considering the suspected cases and their initially asymptomatic contacts, 189 individuals were traced and monitored (Figure 2)12, mostly from the local commerce sector and health services, via home visits or telephone follow-up. The monitoring period spanned 30 days after the last exposure to a confirmed case for asymptomatic contacts or until the onset of signs and symptoms compatible with measles - at which point they were then considered suspected cases.Figure 2Transmission network of measles cases obtained from epidemiological investigation and contact tracing (Go.Data). Campos Lindos, Tocantins State, Brazil, 2025 8 , 12 (data up to November 4, 2025, subject to change).The investigation indicated that the outbreak began after the return of the primary case from Bolivia, with subsequent transmission to family members and a health professional, who generated new transmission chains. This study found the transmission chain for 22 (91.6%) secondary cases. However, it was impossible to identify any possible contact with confirmed cases for two cases from the general population.Before the outbreak, the municipality had vaccination coverage of 123.33% for the first dose (D1) and 76.67% for the second dose (D2) in children aged under two years. Intensified vaccination activities targeting individuals aged six months to 59 years began after notification of the index case (case 5), including ring vaccination and vaccination sweep activities. Members of the Old Believers community received 17 doses, 27.9% of the estimated population (61 individuals) residing in urban and rural areas of the municipality.Given the successive identification of cases, vaccine hesitancy within the Old Believers community, low D2 vaccination coverage, and the risk of sustained transmission in Brazil, a selective vaccination intensification strategy was implemented throughout the municipality to create a protective “cocoon” for individuals adhering to vaccination. A vaccination campaign day (“D-Day”) was organized using the two municipal primary healthcare facilities as fixed vaccination sites and a church and local food market as outreach sites since these locations had greater population circulation.These strategies lead to the administration of 2,113 doses of measles-containing vaccines to individuals aged from six months up to 59 years in Campos Lindos, corresponding to 24.4% of its population. Among children under two years of age, vaccination coverage increased to 127.10% for D1 and 107.48% for D2, a 38% increase when compared with the pre-outbreak period.To increase sensitivity in identifying unreported cases, a search for active community cases was conducted from July 20 to 30, 2025, including a retrospective investigation of signs and symptoms compatible with measles from July 1 onward. In total, six teams (24 professionals) visited 280 households and interviewed 410 individuals, finding no suspected cases. Active institutional case finding was also conducted in the health services of the municipality, manually and electronically reviewing 1,488 medical records, including the Citizen Electronic Health Record, without further cases being identified.In addition to the actions carried out in Campos Lindos, 603 health professionals from 49 municipalities in Tocantins State received training sessions on measles surveillance and outbreak response. Meetings were also held with health managers from four municipalities in Tocantins to strengthen awareness regarding surveillance and vaccination intensification in the region. Vaccination activities were intensified in surrounding municipalities, culminating in a statewide vaccination day across Tocantins state on August 9, 2025. DISCUSSIONThe measles outbreak in Campos Lindos, Tocantins, involved 25 cases, concentrated among unvaccinated individuals from a traditional Russian-origin community (Old Believers) following viral reintroduction associated with international travel. Timely outbreak investigation, laboratory confirmation, and immunization strategies interrupted viral transmission.The rapid increase in vaccination coverage was decisive in interrupting transmission and preventing the expansion of the outbreak to other municipalities. Vaccination coverage exceeding 100% likely reflects an underestimation of the population denominator stemming from the registration of live births in other municipalities, a common situation in locations without maternity healthcare services, such as Campos Lindos.The adopted vaccination intensification strategies, based on intensive vaccination of populations surrounding identified cases and susceptible individuals, established a protective immunological buffer. Conceptually, this approach corresponds to “ring vaccination,” which aims to create zones of immunity around confirmed cases, interrupting further spread beyond the initial focus of transmission 13 . These strategies may be applied preventively (before epidemics occur) and in containment during outbreaks aiming to limit disease propagation 13 , 14 .The outbreak was declared over after 12 weeks without new cases, on December 5, 2025, contributing to the maintenance of measles elimination in Brazil. The control of this outbreak stemmed from integrated strategies between the three levels of Brazilian Unified Health System governance and implemented actions in other municipalities in the Tocantins State and in a neighboring state. CONCLUSIONSOld Believers communities maintain distinct religious practices, strong internal cohesion, rural and domestic lifestyles, and lower daily circulation in collective or public environments 15 . These communities occur in municipalities in Mato Grosso, Parana, and Goias states and in countries such as Bolivia, the United States, and Canada. Intense people interaction occurs between these communities, including via marriages, which increases the group’s transnational mobility. The investigated outbreak showed a high proportion of unvaccinated individuals and resistance to vaccination. Mobility between countries with active viral circulation, low vaccination coverage, and strong interaction within members of the community contributed to the increase in case numbers. Similar situations have been described in outbreaks among Amish communities and other groups with low vaccination adherence in North America 16 , 17 .The outbreak showed the high transmissibility of the virus in susceptible populations and the risk of viral reintroduction in Brazil by international travelers. The retrospective identification of the primary case highlights the need for sensitive surveillance systems capable of early detection, immediate response, and appropriate differential diagnoses. Ring vaccination proved to be an effective strategy in contexts of vaccine hesitancy to contain transmission. Municipalities should, therefore, identify pockets of susceptible individuals, vaccinate them, and, when necessary, adopt this approach to contain further disease spread. INTRODUCTIONBrazil lost its measles elimination status in 2019 following virus reintroduction and sustained transmission for more than 12 months. The country was then recertified in November 2024 after strengthening surveillance and immunization activities1. In this context, outbreaks have occurred in several countries that had previously achieved measles-free status, including in North and South America, highlighting the risk of reintroduction associated with international mobility and vaccine hesitancy 2 , 3 . In July 2025, a measles outbreak occurred in the municipality of Campos Lindos, Tocantins State, after the return of a family from Bolivia, a country with active measles transmission 4 . Although the municipality had a predominantly vaccinated population, cases were concentrated in a specific group. ACKNOWLEDGMENTSWe would like to thank the health professionals from the Campos Lindos municipality and the Tocantins State who were directly involved in field activities and local engagement during this investigation. title_original: Measles outbreak in a unique sociocultural context: epidemiological investigation and control measures in Northern Brazil, 2025

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate a measles outbreak in a unique sociocultural context and evaluate the effectiveness of control measures in preventing further transmission.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A descriptive study was conducted in Campos Lindos, a municipality in Tocantins State, northern Brazil, with an estimated population of 8,653 inhabitants in 2025. The outbreak involved 25 confirmed cases, predominantly among unvaccinated Old Believers, a traditional Russian-origin community, following viral introduction linked to international travel.
analysis.methods: The investigation included interviews with suspected and confirmed cases, clinical sample collection, contact tracing and monitoring, active community case finding, review of medical records from two Brazilian Unified Health System health services, immunization activities, and training of health professionals. Samples with detectable polymerase chain reaction were sequenced to identify the genotype of the measles virus.
analysis.main_results: A total of 25 cases were confirmed over a 70-day surveillance period, with the highest incidence occurring in July 2025. Of these, 13 were confirmed by polymerase chain reaction, two by reactive IgM serology, and 10 by epidemiological linkage. The measles virus genotype D8, lineage MVs/Ontario.CAN/47.24, was identified, consistent with documented viral circulation in Bolivia, Mexico, the United States, and Canada. The transmission chain analysis showed that 84% of the cases occurred within the Old Believers community, of whom 91% had no record of measles vaccination.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The outbreak highlighted the high proportion of unvaccinated individuals and resistance to vaccination within the Old Believers community, as well as the risk of viral reintroduction in Brazil by international travelers. The findings underscore the importance of targeted vaccination strategies in preventing sustained transmission.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study provides insights into the challenges of measles control in communities with low vaccination coverage and vaccine hesitancy, emphasizing the need for sensitive surveillance systems and tailored immunization strategies to prevent outbreaks and protect vulnerable populations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's retrospective nature and reliance on self-reported vaccination records may introduce bias. The evidence is moderate, as the findings are based on surveillance data and community-based interventions, with some limitations in determining the exact source of infection for certain cases.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated a measles outbreak in Campos Lindos, Tocantins, Brazil, which primarily affected unvaccinated members of the Old Believers community, a traditional Russian-origin group. The outbreak was linked to international travel, and the measles virus genotype D8 was identified, consistent with circulation in Bolivia, Mexico, the United States, and Canada. The investigation involved interviews, contact tracing, and active case finding, revealing high transmission rates within the community due to low vaccination adherence. Intensified vaccination strategies, including ring vaccination and outreach efforts, were implemented to create an immunological buffer. The study highlights the challenges of measles control in culturally distinct communities with vaccine hesitancy and underscores the importance of targeted surveillance and immunization. However, the retrospective nature of the data and reliance on self-reported vaccination records limit the confidence in the findings, resulting in a moderate evidence assessment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在在独特的社会文化背景下调查 麻疹 传播 并评估控制措施在预防进一步 传播 方面的有效性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在巴西北部托坎廷斯州坎波斯林多斯市进行了一项描述性研究,该市到 2025 年估计人口为 8,653 人。暴发 涉及 25 例确诊病例,其中主要是未接种疫苗的老信徒社区,这是一个传统的俄罗斯裔社区,病毒传播与国际旅行有关。
elements_zh.methods: 调查包括采访疑似和确诊病例、临床样本收集、接触者追踪和监测、积极的社区病例发现、审查巴西统一卫生系统两个卫生服务机构的医疗记录、免疫活动以及卫生专业人员的培训。对具有可检测聚合酶链反应的样品进行测序,以鉴定 麻疹病毒 的基因型。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 70 天的 监测 期间,总共确诊了 25 例病例,最高的 发病率 发生在 2025 年 7 月。其中,13 例通过聚合酶链反应确诊,2 例通过反应性 IgM 血清学 确诊,10 例通过流行病学连锁确诊。鉴定出 麻疹病毒 基因型 D8,谱系 MVs/Ontario.CAN/47.24,与玻利维亚、墨西哥、美国和加拿大记录的病毒传播一致。传播链分析显示,84%的病例发生在老信徒社区内,其中91%的人没有麻疹 疫苗接种的记录。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 暴发 强调了老信徒社区内未接种疫苗的个人比例很高以及对 疫苗接种 的抵抗力,以及国际旅行者在巴西重新引入病毒的风险。研究结果强调了有针对性的 疫苗接种 策略在预防持续 传播 方面的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究深入了解了 麻疹 覆盖率低和 疫苗 犹豫不决的社区中 麻疹 控制的挑战,强调需要敏感的 监测 系统和量身定制的免疫策略来预防 暴发 并保护弱势群体。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的回顾性和对自我报告 疫苗接种 记录的依赖可能会引入偏差。证据是中等的,因为研究结果是基于 监测 数据和基于社区的干预措施,在确定某些病例的确切感染源方面存在一些局限性。

full_text: New York has just declared a state of emergency as measles cases continue to rise. So far this year, the US has recorded 3,887 cases of measles, the highest annual total since 1991. That is about 70% more cases than were recorded during the whole of 2025. In November, the Pan American Health Organization will review whether the US has lost the measles elimination status it has held since 2000. Cases are one thing, but the number of deaths is more complicated. A dispute has developed between the state of Pennsylvania and federal health officials over how many people have died. Pennsylvania, where the outbreak has reached 1,004 cases, has reported five measles-related deaths since late August. But the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has counted two measles deaths nationally in 2026. The CDC has not said where those two deaths occurred, so it is unclear whether either is among the five reported in Pennsylvania. No other state has reported measles deaths this year. What the argument is about Part of the disagreement comes down to how a measles-related death is defined. Pennsylvania counts a death as measles-associated if the person had a laboratory-confirmed measles infection and died within 30 days of developing symptoms, unless there is another clear cause of death, such as a car crash. The state says it based its definition on national definitions used for deaths from flu and RSV (a common respiratory infection). The CDC adds a death only once its National Center for Health Statistics has verified that measles was listed as the underlying cause. So there is no agreed national definition of a measles death, though the CDC says that it is working on one. The two approaches can produce different answers in difficult cases, and Pennsylvania has had several. The Lancaster County coroner concluded that a newborn who tested positive for measles died of a lacerated spleen and that measles did not contribute. The same coroner found that a second infant, who had a rare and usually fatal genetic condition, did die of measles. In a third case, the Mifflin County coroner attributed an 18-year-old’s death to acute disseminated encephalomyelitis, a rare and severe neurological complication of measles – so, a confirmed measles-related death. But the dispute has not stayed technical. The CDC initially included the first two Pennsylvania deaths, then removed them after the US Health Secretary, Robert F. Kennedy Jr, questioned whether measles had caused them. Leaving out deaths reported by a state is a departure from the agency’s usual practice. The count matters to both sides: more deaths strengthen the case for vaccination, fewer fit the view that the risk is overstated. RFK Jr, who has for years questioned vaccines but describes himself as “pro-safety” rather than anti-vaccine, has accused politicians of exaggerating the threat from infectious diseases to frighten the public. He also suggested that the Pennsylvania deaths may have been “fabricated by one of the Governor’s hopeful staffers”. Pennsylvania’s Democratic governor Josh Shapiro says Kennedy’s actions and the administration’s rhetoric are harming communities across America. The state has threatened to withdraw a request for CDC outbreak support unless the deaths are recognised – a move the federal health department has described as “political blackmail” Why the count matters These are Pennsylvania’s first measles deaths in 35 years, from a vaccine-preventable disease the US declared eliminated in 2000. The fact that measles deaths are happening again shows how far the country has moved from the situation it had achieved through vaccination. That makes the dispute over how many people have died more than a technical argument about definitions. Andrew Pavia of the Infectious Diseases Society of America said the effect of this dispute is confusing the public and undermining trust in the CDC. And this confusion has the biggest impact where vaccination rates are lowest. Measles is so contagious that a community needs more than 95% of people vaccinated to stop it spreading. Below that, outbreaks take hold, and the people most at risk are those who cannot protect themselves, such as babies too young for the vaccine, which is normally given at 12 to 15 months. Across the US, MMR coverage is lower among children who are uninsured or on Medicaid, living below the poverty line or living in rural areas. Averages also hide local gaps. In Lancaster County, 88% of pupils were vaccinated against measles last school year, against 97% across Pennsylvania. These are the communities where clear information about risk matters most. When official figures conflict, it is harder to tell people how serious an outbreak is, and harder to make the case for sending staff and vaccines their way. The UK lost its own elimination status in January, and a child died of measles in Liverpool in July 2025. Only 85% of five-year-olds in England have had both MMR doses, against a 95% target. Coverage also follows deprivation: in 2016-17 England’s most deprived areas had slightly higher MMR coverage than the least deprived, by 2024-25 they were 7.6 percentage points behind. In both countries, health services need accurate, consistent figures to know where those gaps are so protection reaches everyone in proportion to need What would help? A couple of practical steps could help. A national definition of a measles death, agreed in advance and applied the same way everywhere, would take the question out of individual disputes. Publishing basic details of each counted death, such as state and age group, would let anyone reconcile federal and state figures. Neither requires anyone to concede a wider political argument. There are encouraging signs on vaccination. By mid-July, Pennsylvania’s state health staff had given more than three times as many MMR doses in Lancaster County as in the whole of 2025. And the UK shows that elimination can be won back, having lost its status in 2018 and regained it again in 2021. If the US loses its status in November, that will describe the past year, rather than decide the next one. Closing the local coverage gaps is what matters most, and it is easier when everyone is working from the same numbers.
